<!--
reports/manuscript-100mlives2-artifacts.Rmd

This file is the only executable source for manuscript-specific calculations, summaries, tables and figures.
It reads existing project inputs, the stage-7 model outputs and the stage-8 deterministic sensitivity outputs
(output/uncertainty/dsa/; it never reruns the model or the sensitivity analyses) and writes:
  manuscript/artifacts/*.rds              scalars, display-ready tables, compact plot data, provenance
  manuscript/tables/*.csv                 every table the manuscript uses (numeric values + status column)
  manuscript/figures/*.png                every reproducible figure panel
  manuscript/manuscript-100mlives2.xlsx   tracking workbook, regenerated (tracking and review only)

Run it in a fresh R process from the repository root (knit output goes to a temporary directory):
  Rscript -e 'rmarkdown::render("reports/manuscript-100mlives2-artifacts.Rmd", output_dir = tempdir())'
then knit manuscript/manuscript-100mlives2.Rmd, which only loads these artifacts.

Rules followed here: data.table for data work and ggplot2 for figures; no tidyverse; no setwd(); all
paths are built from the repository root; the generated workbook and earlier artifact builds are never
read as inputs; results that cannot be recalculated yet keep their legacy values and are tagged
REPRO_PENDING (search for that tag here and in the manuscript).
-->

```{r setup, include=FALSE}
knitr::opts_chunk$set(echo = FALSE, message = FALSE, warning = FALSE, comment = NA)
options(width = 160, datatable.print.nrows = 200)

req_pkgs <- c("data.table", "ggplot2", "rprojroot", "openxlsx", "sf", "rnaturalearth",
              "rnaturalearthdata", "ggbeeswarm", "ggdist", "scales", "knitr")
miss_pkgs <- req_pkgs[!vapply(req_pkgs, requireNamespace, logical(1), quietly = TRUE)]
if (length(miss_pkgs)) stop("Install these R packages before knitting: ", paste(miss_pkgs, collapse = ", "))
library(data.table)
library(ggplot2)

# ---- Paths: built from the repository root, so this knits from the root, reports/ or manuscript/ ----
root <- rprojroot::find_root(rprojroot::has_file("uw-rtsl-100mlives2.Rproj"))
rp <- function(...) file.path(root, ...)
dir_art  <- rp("manuscript", "artifacts")
dir_tab  <- rp("manuscript", "tables")
dir_fig  <- rp("manuscript", "figures")
xlsx_out <- rp("manuscript", "manuscript-100mlives2.xlsx")
for (d in c(dir_art, dir_tab, dir_fig)) dir.create(d, showWarnings = FALSE, recursive = TRUE)

# ---- Analysis window ----------------------------------------------------------------------------
yr_impl_start <- 2026L                        # first intervention year (checked against the model code)
yr_end        <- 2050L
n_impl_years  <- yr_end - yr_impl_start + 1L  # 25 = divisor for every "per year" average (2026-2050)
# Cumulative BAU/projected totals and % reductions sum years yr_cum_start-2050: the stated 2026-2050
# horizon (authors' decision, 2026-11-03). The report and the legacy values used 2025-2050
# (data.out[year >= 2025]); deaths delayed are zero in 2025 (checked below), so only BAU totals,
# projected totals and percentages differ from the legacy values.
yr_cum_start  <- 2026L
win_cum       <- yr_cum_start:yr_end
yr_obs_end     <- 2018L                      # last input-derived historical year plotted (report: b_rates[year < 2019])
src_input <- "Model inputs: GBD 2023 rates x UN-WPP 2024"   # historical deaths implied by inputs, not simulated
src_bau   <- "This study: BAU projection"
yr_model_start <- 2019L                       # first projection year plotted from the model outputs

# ---- Intervention labels (report chunk `output-data`) --------------------------------------------
int_raw <- c(baseline = "BAU", BP = "HTN", Salt = "Sodium", TFA = "TFA", Statins = "Statins",
             "BP + Salt + TFA + Statins" = "All")
scen_of_int <- c(baseline = "baseline", BP = "bp_only", Salt = "sodium_only", TFA = "tfa_only",
                 Statins = "statins_only", "BP + Salt" = "bp_sodium", "BP + Salt + TFA" = "bp_sodium_tfa",
                 "BP + Salt + TFA + Statins" = "all_four")   # "BP + Salt" and "BP + Salt + TFA" are not reported
int_label <- c(BAU = "Business-as-Usual", HTN = "Improved Hypertension Control",
               Sodium = "Population Sodium Reduction", TFA = "TFA Elimination",
               Statins = "Improved Statin Uptake", All = "All Interventions")
int_single <- c("HTN", "Sodium", "TFA", "Statins")
int_table  <- c("All", int_single)

# ---- Table S8: mortality-trend blocks ------------------------------------------------------------
# Base case = the production run (output/out_model/, manifest MRM). The three alternatives are the
# stage-8 deterministic sensitivity analyses (code/8.<n>_sensitivity_*.R): same calibration, runner,
# inputs and intervention scenarios, each with a fresh stage-6 baseline built with its own trend
# switches. Their country files are read from output/uncertainty/dsa/out_model_<block>/out_model/
# (the unchanged stage-7 runner appends out_model/ to its output folder) and their provenance from
# output/uncertainty/dsa/out_model_<block>/dsa_manifest.rds. The switches below are the expected
# definitions, checked against each manifest. Every block uses the main results' window W
# (2026-2050), countries, sexes, ages and causes, with its own BAU as comparator.
s8_dsa <- data.table(
  block = c("lc", "no_trends", "ihme_foresight"),
  label = c("Background and CVD trend LC", "No background and no CVD trend", "IHME Foresight trends"),
  mortality_trend_method = c("legacy", "coherent", "coherent"),
  run_bgmx_trend    = c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE),
  run_CF_trend      = c(TRUE, FALSE, TRUE),
  run_CF_trend_80   = c(FALSE, FALSE, FALSE),
  run_CF_trend_ihme = c(FALSE, FALSE, TRUE))
s8_dsa[, dir := rp("output", "uncertainty", "dsa", paste0("out_model_", block))]
s8_int <- c("HTN", "Sodium", "TFA", "Statins", "All")   # row order within each Table S8 block

# ---- Causes (the four modelled CVD causes; there is no pre-aggregated "all" cause in the outputs) ----
cause_map <- c(ihd = "Ischemic heart disease", istroke = "Ischemic stroke",
               hstroke = "Intracerebral hemorrhage", hhd = "Hypertensive heart disease")

# ---- Age groups (report chunk `output-data`: cut at 70, 80, 90, right-open) ----------------------
age_levels   <- c("<70", "70-79", "80-89", "90+")
age_group_of <- function(age) fcase(age < 70, "<70", age < 80, "70-79", age < 90, "80-89", default = "90+")

# ---- Regions (report chunk `transversals`): World Bank names -> model names, plus missing countries --
region_name_fix <- c(
  "United States of America" = "United States", "Egypt, Arab Rep." = "Egypt",
  "Congo, Dem. Rep." = "Democratic Republic of the Congo", "Congo, Rep." = "Congo",
  "Yemen, Rep." = "Yemen", "Slovak Republic" = "Slovakia",
  "Venezuela, RB" = "Venezuela (Bolivarian Republic of)", "Vietnam" = "Viet Nam",
  "Cote d'Ivoire" = "Ivory Coast", "Korea, Rep." = "Republic of Korea",
  "Iran, Islamic Rep." = "Iran (Islamic Republic of)", "Czech Republic" = "Czechia",
  "Bahamas, The" = "Bahamas", "Gambia, The" = "Gambia", "Lao PDR" = "Lao People's Democratic Republic",
  "Moldova" = "Republic of Moldova", "Micronesia, Fed. Sts." = "Micronesia (Federated States of)")
region_add <- data.table(
  iso3     = c("LCA", "PRK", "VCT", "KGZ", "PSE", "TWN"),
  location = c("Saint Lucia", "Democratic People's Republic of Korea", "Saint Vincent and the Grenadines",
               "Kyrgyzstan", "Palestine", "Taiwan (Province of China)"),
  region   = c("Latin America and Caribbean", "Southeast Asia, East Asia, and Oceania",
               "Latin America and Caribbean", "Central Europe, Eastern Europe, and Central Asia",
               "North Africa and Middle East", "Southeast Asia, East Asia, and Oceania"))
region_abbr <- c(ssa = "Sub-Saharan Africa", seao = "Southeast Asia, East Asia, and Oceania",
                 sa = "South Asia", lac = "Latin America and Caribbean",
                 cee = "Central Europe, Eastern Europe, and Central Asia",
                 name = "North Africa and Middle East", hi = "High-income")

# ---- Excluded locations (report: locs_exclude <- NULL; Greenland and Bermuda were never run) -------
locs_exclude <- character(0)

# ---- Standard population: WHO World Standard Population 2000-2025 ------------------------------
# Ahmad OB, Boschi-Pinto C, Lopez AD, Murray CJL, Lozano R, Inoue M. Age standardization of rates: a new WHO
# standard. GPE Discussion Paper Series No. 31. Geneva: World Health Organization; 2001. Table 4 (p. 12),
# "WHO World Standard Population Distribution (%), based on world average population between 2000-2025";
# checked against the WHO PDF and SEER's copy ("World (WHO 2000-2025) Standard"), which agree. Ages 20-95+:
# each five-year weight is split equally over its five single ages (20-94), the open row 95 takes the 95-99
# and 100+ weights (0.04 + 0.005), and the 20-95+ weights are rescaled to sum to one. The same fixed weights
# are used for every year, sex and series. (The report's former 10-year step weights were not this standard
# and are no longer used.)
who_std_pct_5y <- c(`20-24` = 8.22, `25-29` = 7.93, `30-34` = 7.61, `35-39` = 7.15, `40-44` = 6.59,
                    `45-49` = 6.04, `50-54` = 5.37, `55-59` = 4.55, `60-64` = 3.72, `65-69` = 2.96,
                    `70-74` = 2.21, `75-79` = 1.52, `80-84` = 0.91, `85-89` = 0.44, `90-94` = 0.15)
who_std_pct_95plus <- 0.04 + 0.005
who_std <- data.table(age = 20:95, weight = c(rep(unname(who_std_pct_5y) / 5, each = 5), who_std_pct_95plus))
who_std_share_20plus <- sum(who_std$weight)   # 65.415% of the all-age standard
who_std[, weight := weight / sum(weight)]
stopifnot(nrow(who_std) == 76L, abs(sum(who_std$weight) - 1) < 1e-12, abs(who_std_share_20plus - 65.415) < 1e-9)
# ASMR per 100,000 from single-age rates: dt has columns age and rate (per person), grouped by `by`.
asmr_of <- function(dt, by) {
  x <- merge(dt, who_std, by = "age")
  if (x[, .N, by = by][, any(N != nrow(who_std))]) stop("asmr_of(): incomplete 20-95 age grid", call. = FALSE)
  x[, .(asmr = 1e5 * sum(weight * rate)), by = by]
}

# ---- Helpers -----------------------------------------------------------------------------------
check <- function(cond, msg) if (!isTRUE(cond)) stop("Check failed: ", msg, call. = FALSE)
need_files <- function(paths) {
  miss <- paths[!file.exists(paths)]
  if (length(miss)) stop("Missing input files:\n  ", paste(miss, collapse = "\n  "), call. = FALSE)
}
need_cols <- function(dt, cols, what) {
  miss <- setdiff(cols, names(dt))
  if (length(miss)) stop(what, ": missing columns ", paste(miss, collapse = ", "), call. = FALSE)
}
fmt_num <- function(x, d = 1) ifelse(is.na(x), "—", formatC(x, format = "f", digits = d, big.mark = ","))
fmt_int <- function(x) ifelse(is.na(x), "—", formatC(round(x), format = "d", big.mark = ","))
fmt_pct <- function(x, d = 1) ifelse(is.na(x), "—", paste0(formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = d), "%"))
num_word <- function(n) c("one", "two", "three", "four", "five", "six", "seven", "eight", "nine", "ten")[n]
blank_repeats <- function(x) { x[c(FALSE, x[-1] == x[-length(x)])] <- ""; x }
esc_md <- function(x) gsub("([*_])", "\\\\\\1", x)
# single-row lookup in a summary table, e.g. g(s_int, "dd", int = "All")
g <- function(tab, col, ...) {
  f <- list(...)
  keep <- rep(TRUE, nrow(tab))
  for (n in names(f)) keep <- keep & tab[[n]] == f[[n]]
  check(sum(keep) == 1, sprintf("lookup %s in %s is not unique", col,
                                paste(names(f), unlist(f), sep = "=", collapse = ", ")))
  tab[[col]][keep]
}
save_rds <- function(obj, name) saveRDS(obj, file.path(dir_art, name), compress = "xz")
save_fig <- function(plot, name, width, height, dpi = 150) {
  ggsave(file.path(dir_fig, name), plot, width = width, height = height, dpi = dpi, bg = "white")
  FIG_DONE[[name]] <<- TRUE
}
FIG_DONE <- list()
```

# 1. Inventory

Every manuscript-specific number, table and figure, in manuscript order. Status values:
`reproduced` (calculated here from repo inputs/outputs), `fixed_external` (published literature,
hard-coded with citation), `static_content` (author-written text) and `preserved_pending` (a model
result that cannot be recalculated yet; legacy value kept and tagged `REPRO_PENDING`). The mortality-trend
sensitivity results (Table S8) are reproduced from the stage-8 runs (section 19). The remaining preserved model
results (Kontis-methods replications, counterfactual runs) come from runs with the legacy
two-pass calibration and the earlier independently forecast (Lee-Carter) mortality trends: they predate the
single-pass calibration in `code/5. calibration.R` and the coherent trends, and are not consistent with the
current model outputs until regenerated. Tables that
combine statuses are `mixed`; their cell-level status is in the CSV `status` column and in the workbook
shading. `legacy` is the value currently displayed in the manuscript/workbook: it is the kept value for
non-reproduced items and the comparison baseline for reproduced ones. Input codes are defined in the
legend that follows. `W` is the cumulative window `yr_cum_start`-2050, i.e. 2026-2050 (setup chunk).

```{r inventory}
                   strip.white = TRUE)
for (j in names(inventory)) set(inventory, which(is.na(inventory[[j]])), j, "")
check(!anyDuplicated(inventory$id), "duplicated inventory ids")
check(all(inventory$status %in% c("reproduced", "fixed_external", "static_content", "preserved_pending", "mixed")),
      "unknown status in inventory")
```

# 2. Inputs and checks

Reads only the files below, through paths built from the repository root. External OneDrive paths in the
report (`NCD-RisC`, `GBD` Foresight, Powles) have byte-identical copies under `data-raw/`, used here.

```{r inputs}

# ---- Model parameters, read from the stage-7 script as text (never sourced) ----
mc_txt <- readLines(in_files$MC, warn = FALSE)
mc_num <- function(pattern) {
  hit <- regmatches(mc_txt, regexpr(pattern, mc_txt, perl = TRUE))
  check(length(hit) >= 1, paste("model-code constant not found:", pattern))
  as.numeric(sub(pattern, "\\1", hit[length(hit)], perl = TRUE))
}

  target_control         = mc_num("^target_control\\s*<-\\s*([0-9.]+)"),
  control_start_year     = mc_num("^control_start_year\\s*<-\\s*([0-9]+)"),
  control_target_year    = mc_num("^control_target_year\\s*<-\\s*([0-9]+)"),
  salteff                = mc_num("^salteff\\s*<-\\s*([0-9.]+)"),
  saltyear1              = mc_num("^saltyear1\\s*<-\\s*([0-9]+)"),
  saltyear2              = mc_num("^saltyear2\\s*<-\\s*([0-9]+)"),
  tfa_target_tfa         = mc_num("^tfa_target_tfa\\s*<-\\s*([0-9.]+)"),
  tfa_policy_start_year  = mc_num("^tfa_policy_start_year\\s*<-\\s*([0-9]+)"),
  statin_target_coverage = mc_num("^statin_target_coverage\\s*<-\\s*([0-9.]+)"),
  statin_start_year      = mc_num("^statin_start_year\\s*<-\\s*([0-9]+)"),
  statin_target_year     = mc_num("^statin_target_year\\s*<-\\s*([0-9]+)"),
  adherence_ir           = mc_num("^adherence_ir\\s*<-\\s*([0-9.]+)"),
  adherence_cf           = mc_num("^adherence_cf\\s*<-\\s*([0-9.]+)"))
check(yr_impl_start == min(mp$control_start_year, mp$saltyear1, mp$statin_start_year, mp$tfa_policy_start_year),
      "yr_impl_start differs from the earliest intervention start year in the model code")

# ---- Stage-7 model outputs: one file per country, aggregated file by file ----
# Adapted from report chunk `output-data`, which rbinds all files into `data.out`. Here each file is
# checked, deaths delayed are computed within matching strata (intervention vs BAU on cause, sex, single
# age and year) and only compact aggregates are kept. Population and all.mx repeat across the four cause
# models, so one copy (ihd) is used for them. The same function reads the stage-8 sensitivity outputs
# (section 19) with acc = FALSE, so every Table S8 block gets identical treatment. shared_pop = FALSE is
# used only for runs whose trends break BG.mx = ALL.mx - DIS.mx.t0 (the independent LC block): the runner
# seeds each cause model's age-20 entrants with Nx * (DIS.mx.t0 + BG.mx), so their populations then drift
# apart slightly; that drift is measured (pop_spread, allmx_spread) and bounded in section 19 instead.
mo_cols <- c("scenario", "age", "cause", "sex", "year", "well", "sick", "newcases", "dead", "pop",
             "all.mx", "intervention", "location")
n_ages  <- length(20:95)
read_model_file <- function(f, acc = TRUE, shared_pop = TRUE) {
  x <- readRDS(f); setDT(x)
  loc <- sub("^model_output_part_(.+)\\.rds$", "\\1", basename(f))
  need_cols(x, mo_cols, basename(f))
  n_rows <- nrow(x)
  check(identical(unique(x$location), loc), paste(loc, ": location column does not match the file name"))
  check(setequal(unique(x$intervention), names(scen_of_int)), paste(loc, ": unexpected intervention labels"))
  check(all(x$scenario == scen_of_int[x$intervention]), paste(loc, ": scenario and intervention labels disagree"))
  check(setequal(unique(x$cause), names(cause_map)), paste(loc, ": unexpected causes"))
  check(setequal(unique(x$sex), c("Female", "Male")), paste(loc, ": unexpected sexes"))
  check(min(x$age) == 20 && max(x$age) == 95, paste(loc, ": ages are not 20-95"))
  check(min(x$year) <= yr_model_start && max(x$year) == yr_end, paste(loc, ": years do not cover", yr_model_start, "-", yr_end))
  x <- x[intervention %in% names(int_raw) & year >= yr_model_start]
  x[, int := unname(int_raw[intervention])]
  # Rows with non-finite states are dropped. Known case: Antigua and Barbuda, BP-only, one male cohort from
  # 2026 plus one duplicated key. Those strata get no deaths delayed (projected = BAU).
  bad <- !(is.finite(x$well) & is.finite(x$sick) & is.finite(x$dead) & is.finite(x$pop) & is.finite(x$all.mx))
  n_bad <- sum(bad); bad_int <- paste(unique(x$int[bad]), collapse = ",")
  x <- x[!bad]
  check(nrow(x[, .N, by = .(int, cause, sex, age, year)][N > 1]) == 0, paste(loc, ": duplicated strata"))
  n_grid <- 4L * 2L * n_ages * (yr_end - yr_model_start + 1L)
  bau <- x[int == "BAU", .(cause, sex, age, year, bau = dead)]
  check(nrow(bau) == n_grid, paste(loc, ": BAU grid is incomplete"))
  check(all(x$dead >= 0), paste(loc, ": negative deaths"))
  rep_dev <- x[, .(d = max(abs(pop - pop[1])) / max(pop[1], 1) + max(abs(all.mx - all.mx[1])) / max(all.mx[1], 1e-9)),
               by = .(int, sex, age, year)][, max(d)]
  if (shared_pop) check(rep_dev < 1e-8, paste(loc, ": pop or all.mx differ across cause models"))
  # population-level spread across the four cause models: BAU adult population and all-cause deaths over W
  sp <- x[int == "BAU" & year %in% win_cum, .(pop = sum(pop), allmx = sum(all.mx)), by = cause]
  y <- merge(x[int != "BAU", .(int, cause, sex, age, year, dead)], bau, by = c("cause", "sex", "age", "year"))
  y[, dd := bau - dead]
  miss <- rbindlist(lapply(setdiff(int_raw, "BAU"), function(i)
    bau[year %in% win_cum][!y[int == i], on = .(cause, sex, age, year)][, .(int = i, n = .N, bau_missing = sum(bau))]))
  y[, age_group := age_group_of(age)]
  bau[, age_group := age_group_of(age)]
  # Single-age sums over countries for the age-standardised rates (Figures S3, S4a), accumulated file by file
  # (one population and all-cause copy: the ihd rows). Dropped non-finite rows (above) are left out.
  if (acc) {
    acc_add("SA", x[, .(dead = sum(dead)), keyby = .(int, cause, sex, age, year)], "dead")
    acc_add("SP", x[cause == "ihd", .(pop = sum(pop), all_mx = sum(all.mx)), keyby = .(int, sex, age, year)], c("pop", "all_mx"))
  }
  list(
    B   = bau[, .(bau = sum(bau)), by = .(cause, sex, age_group, year)][, location := loc],
    D   = y[, .(dd = sum(dd)), by = .(int, cause, sex, age_group, year)][, location := loc],
    PJ  = merge(x[int != "BAU" & year %in% win_cum, .(proj_direct = sum(dead)), by = int], miss, by = "int")[, location := loc],
    AC  = x[int == "BAU" & cause == "ihd", .(all_mx = sum(all.mx), pop = sum(pop)), by = .(sex, year)][, location := loc],
    LOG = data.table(location = loc, rows = n_rows, dropped_rows = n_bad, dropped_in = bad_int, duplicated_strata = 0L,
                     cause_copy_deviation = rep_dev, pop_spread = sp[, (max(pop) - min(pop)) / mean(pop)],
                     allmx_spread = sp[, (max(allmx) - min(allmx)) / mean(allmx)], strata_without_effect = sum(miss$n),
                     dd_before_start = y[year < yr_impl_start, sum(abs(dd))], min_dd = min(y$dd)))
}
# Running sums keyed by stratum: ACC[[name]] holds the sum over the files read so far.
ACC <- list()
acc_add <- function(name, agg, cols) {
  if (is.null(ACC[[name]])) { ACC[[name]] <<- agg; return(invisible()) }
  keys <- setdiff(names(agg), cols)
  both <- rbind(ACC[[name]], agg)
  ACC[[name]] <<- both[, lapply(.SD, sum), keyby = keys, .SDcols = cols]
}
mo_files <- sort(list.files(in_files$MO, pattern = "^model_output_part_.+\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE))
check(length(mo_files) > 0, "no model output files found")
mo <- lapply(mo_files, read_model_file)
B      <- rbindlist(lapply(mo, `[[`, "B"))
D      <- rbindlist(lapply(mo, `[[`, "D"))
PJ     <- rbindlist(lapply(mo, `[[`, "PJ"))
AC     <- rbindlist(lapply(mo, `[[`, "AC"))
mo_log <- rbindlist(lapply(mo, `[[`, "LOG"))
rm(mo); invisible(gc())

B <- B[location %in% locs]; D <- D[location %in% locs]; PJ <- PJ[location %in% locs]; AC <- AC[location %in% locs]

check(D[year < yr_impl_start, sum(abs(dd))] < 1e-6, "deaths delayed before the first intervention year")
check(all(is.finite(B$bau)) && all(is.finite(D$dd)) && all(is.finite(AC$all_mx)), "non-finite aggregates")
```

```{r core}
# ---- Core summary used by every section: BAU and deaths delayed (DD) summed over strata ----
# DD = BAU - intervention, computed within matching strata in read_model_file(). The combined effect is
# the simulated "All" scenario, never a sum of the separate effects.
# BB, DD: the BAU and deaths-delayed aggregates of one model run (default: the main run; section 19
# passes those of each stage-8 sensitivity run).
summ <- function(by = character(0), years = win_cum, ints = int_table, where = NULL, BB = B, DD = D) {
  bb <- BB[year %in% years]; dd <- DD[year %in% years & int %in% ints]
  if (!is.null(where)) { bb <- bb[eval(where)]; dd <- dd[eval(where)] }
  if (length(by)) {
    out <- merge(dd[, .(dd = sum(dd)), by = c("int", by)], bb[, .(bau = sum(bau)), by = by], by = by, all.x = TRUE)
  } else {
    out <- dd[, .(dd = sum(dd)), by = "int"][, bau := sum(bb$bau)]
  }
  check(!anyNA(out$bau), "summ(): deaths delayed without a BAU denominator")
  out[, `:=`(proj = bau - dd, pct = dd / bau, per_year = dd / n_impl_years)]
  out[]
}
s_int   <- summ()
s_cause <- summ("cause")
s_sex   <- summ("sex")
s_age   <- summ("age_group")
s_u70   <- summ("u70")
s_reg   <- summ("region")
s_loc   <- summ(c("region", "location"))

# projected deaths: BAU - DD equals the direct sum of intervention deaths plus BAU deaths in no-effect strata
pj_chk <- merge(PJ[, .(proj_direct = sum(proj_direct), bau_missing = sum(bau_missing)), by = int], s_int[, .(int, proj)], by = "int")
check(pj_chk[, max(abs(proj_direct + bau_missing - proj) / proj)] < 1e-9, "projected deaths do not reconcile")

# ---- Scalar registry: values are set once, by inventory id ----
SC <- list()
set_sc <- function(key, value, display, note = "") {
  inv <- inventory[match(key, inventory$id)]
  check(!is.na(inv$type) && inv$type == "scalar", paste("set_sc(): unknown scalar", key))
  check(inv$status == "reproduced", paste("set_sc(): scalar", key, "is not marked reproduced"))
  check(is.null(SC[[key]]), paste("set_sc(): scalar", key, "set twice"))
  check(length(value) == 1 && is.finite(value), paste("set_sc(): non-finite value for", key))
  SC[[key]] <<- list(value = unname(value), display = unname(display), note = note)
}
scM <- function(key, x, d = 1) set_sc(key, x / 1e6, fmt_num(x / 1e6, d))
scP <- function(key, p, d = 1) set_sc(key, 100 * p, formatC(100 * p, format = "f", digits = d))
reg_pct <- function(i, r) g(s_reg, "pct", int = i, region = region_abbr[[r]])

# ---- Table registry: CSV values, display strings and cell statuses ----
TB <- list()
add_table <- function(sheet, csv, display, status, bold = integer(), numfmt = character(0)) {
  csv <- as.data.table(csv); display <- as.data.frame(display, check.names = FALSE)
  if (length(status) == 1) status <- matrix(status, nrow(csv), ncol(csv))
  check(identical(dim(status), dim(csv)), paste(sheet, ": status matrix does not match the CSV"))
  check(nrow(display) == nrow(csv), paste(sheet, ": display and CSV rows differ"))
  check(!anyNA(as.matrix(display)), paste(sheet, ": NA in display strings"))
  TB[[sheet]] <<- list(csv = csv, display = display, status = status, bold = bold, numfmt = numfmt)
}
PD <- list()   # compact plot data (aggregates only)
```

# 3. Abstract and Methods: coverage

Reads model output locations and UN-WPP 2019 population (report chunk `output-data`, `pop_coverage`).

```{r abstract-methods}
set_sc("n_countries", length(locs), as.character(length(locs)))
pop19 <- POP[year_id == 2019 & age >= 20, .(Nx = sum(Nx, na.rm = TRUE)), by = location]
cov_pct <- 100 * pop19[location %in% locs, sum(Nx)] / pop19[, sum(Nx)]
set_sc("pop_coverage_pct", cov_pct, as.character(floor(cov_pct)),
       note = sprintf("%.2f%% of the 2019 UN-WPP population aged 20+ (%d locations); floored", cov_pct, nrow(pop19)))
```

# 4. Table 1: intervention scenarios

Baseline column: 2025 population-weighted means over the 190 countries, weights = 2019 UN-WPP population
summed over all ages in `POP` (report chunks `out-policy-salt`, `out-policy-tf`, `out-policy-statins`).
TFA uses the report's definition (GBD 2024 intake at ages 50-54 from `TFAD`, both sexes), which reproduces
the legacy 0.4%; the 2025 scenario baseline in `TFAS` is lower (countries with bans are set to 0) and is
printed below. The hypertension baseline (37%) is preserved: no repo input reproduces it.

```{r table1}
w19 <- POP[year_id == 2019, .(w = sum(Nx, na.rm = TRUE)), by = location][location %in% locs]
wmean <- function(dt, col, min_n = length(locs) - 1) {
  x <- merge(dt[location %in% locs], w19, by = "location")
  check(uniqueN(x$location) >= min_n, paste("Table 1 baseline: too few countries for", col))
  x[, weighted.mean(get(col), w)]
}
tfad <- copy(TFAD)
tfad[location == "United States of America", location := "United States"]
tfad[location == "Bolivia (Plurinational State of)", location := "Bolivia"]
tfad[location == "United Republic of Tanzania", location := "Tanzania"]
t1_base <- c(
  sodium  = wmean(SOD[year == 2025], "sodium_current"),
  tfa     = wmean(tfad[age == "50 to 54" & year == 2024 & !is.na(tfa_current)], "tfa_current"),
  statins = wmean(STA[year == 2025], "statins_current"))
t1_alt <- data.table(
  item  = c("HTN control among hypertensives, 2025 (HBP baseline_ctrl)", "TFA scenario baseline, 2025 (TFAS tfa_current)",
            "NCD-RisC 2019 treated among hypertensives (unweighted mean of sexes)"),
  value = c(wmean(HBP[year == 2025], "baseline_ctrl"), wmean(TFAS[year == 2025], "tfa_current"),
            wmean(NCD[Year == 2019, .(location = Country, v = treated)][, .(v = mean(v)), by = location], "v", min_n = 100)))
knitr::kable(data.table(item = names(t1_base), value = signif(t1_base, 6)), caption = "Table 1: reproduced baselines at full precision")
knitr::kable(t1_alt[, .(item, value = signif(value, 3))], caption = "Table 1: alternative baselines (not used; for the authors)")

# Static columns: legacy workbook T1_Scenarios!A3:G7 (author-written)
t1 <- data.table(
  Intervention = c("Improved Hypertension Control", "Population Sodium Reduction", "TFA Elimination", "Improved Statin Uptake"),
  `Outcomes Impacted` = c("IHD, Ischemic Stroke, Hemorrhagic Stroke, Hypertensive Heart Disease",
                          "IHD, Ischemic Stroke, Hemorrhagic Stroke, Hypertensive Heart Disease", "IHD", "IHD and Ischemic Stroke"),
  RR = c("IR per 10 mmHg reduction in SBP (age-specific/SBP- specific)\nCF per 10 mmHg reduction in SBP\nCF/IR: 0.83 IHD\nCF/IR 0.73 stroke\nCF/IR 0.72 HHD",
         "IR per 1 g/day reduction in sodium intake:\nIR: 0.83 IHD\nIR 0.73 stroke\nIR 0.72 HHD",
         "CF: 1.07-1.21per 1 %E energy from industrial (Age dependent)",
         "CF: 0.8 IHD Everybody. Ischemic stroke (100%) with atherosclerotic cause (60% fixed)\nIR: 0.78 Applied only to the proportion with Diabetes AF"),
  `Risk population` = c("Adults 20 + y with hypertension", "Adults 20 +", "Adults 20 +", "Adults 40+ with prior IHD or stroke (secondary)"),
  `Baseline level (2025)` = c("37 % of hypertensives treated to SBP < 140 mmHg",   # REPRO_PENDING: source not identified
                              sprintf("Mean intake %s g/day", fmt_num(t1_base[["sodium"]], 1)),
                              sprintf("%s%% of energy intake", fmt_num(100 * t1_base[["tfa"]], 1)),
                              sprintf("%s %% coverage of statins as primary prevention", fmt_num(100 * t1_base[["statins"]], 0))),
  Target = c("50 % controlled by 2040", "−30 % (2.9 g) by 2030", "0 % by 2028", "60 % by 2050"),
  `Scale-up pattern` = rep("Linear", 4))
t1_csv <- copy(t1)[, `:=`(baseline_value = c(NA, t1_base[["sodium"]], 100 * t1_base[["tfa"]], 100 * t1_base[["statins"]]),
                          baseline_unit = c("% controlled (preserved)", "g/day", "% of energy", "% coverage"))]
t1_status <- matrix("static_content", nrow(t1_csv), ncol(t1_csv), dimnames = list(NULL, names(t1_csv)))
t1_status[, c("Baseline level (2025)", "baseline_value")] <- c(rep("preserved_pending", 1), rep("reproduced", 3))
t1_disp <- copy(t1)[, RR := gsub(":; ", ": ", gsub("\r?\n", "; ", RR))]
add_table("T1_Scenarios", t1_csv, t1_disp, t1_status, numfmt = c(baseline_value = "0.00"))
```

# 5. Results text, Table 2 and Discussion numbers

Adapted from report chunks `out-tab-int-caut` (all-CVD totals), `out-tab-int-cau` (by cause; the TFA rows
for stroke/HHD and the statin rows for ICH/HHD are dropped, as in the report), `1out-int-age` (sex and age)
and `out-tab-loc` (regions). Percentages are deaths delayed / BAU deaths. All values are all-age unless the
key says `u70`/`o70`, even where the text says "premature".

```{r results-numbers}
dd_all <- g(s_int, "dd", int = "All")
scM("dd_all_total_M", dd_all, 1); scM("dd_all_total_M_r0", dd_all, 0)
scP("dd_all_pct", g(s_int, "pct", int = "All"), 1); scP("dd_all_pct_r0", g(s_int, "pct", int = "All"), 0)
scM("dd_all_per_year_M_1d", g(s_int, "per_year", int = "All"), 1)
scM("dd_all_per_year_M_2d", g(s_int, "per_year", int = "All"), 2)
scM("bau_total_M", g(s_int, "bau", int = "All"), 1)
scM("proj_all_total_M", g(s_int, "proj", int = "All"), 1)
for (cc in names(cause_map)) {
  scM(sprintf("dd_%s_all_M", cc), g(s_cause, "dd", int = "All", cause = cc), 1)
  scP(sprintf("pct_%s_all", cc), g(s_cause, "pct", int = "All", cause = cc), 1)
}
dd_stroke <- g(s_cause, "dd", int = "All", cause = "istroke") + g(s_cause, "dd", int = "All", cause = "hstroke")
scM("dd_stroke_all_M", dd_stroke, 1)
scP("share_ihd_stroke_pct", (g(s_cause, "dd", int = "All", cause = "ihd") + dd_stroke) / dd_all, 0)
scM("dd_htn_total_M", g(s_int, "dd", int = "HTN"), 1); scM("dd_htn_total_M_r0", g(s_int, "dd", int = "HTN"), 0)
scM("dd_sodium_total_M", g(s_int, "dd", int = "Sodium"), 1)
scM("dd_statins_total_M", g(s_int, "dd", int = "Statins"), 1); scM("dd_statins_total_M_r0", g(s_int, "dd", int = "Statins"), 0)
scM("dd_tfa_total_M", g(s_int, "dd", int = "TFA"), 1)

# sex and age
p_f <- g(s_sex, "pct", int = "All", sex = "Female"); p_m <- g(s_sex, "pct", int = "All", sex = "Male")
p_sex <- sort(unique(formatC(100 * c(p_f, p_m), format = "f", digits = 0)))
set_sc("pct_all_sex_common_r0", 100 * (p_f + p_m) / 2, paste(p_sex, collapse = "–"),
       note = sprintf("women %.2f%%, men %.2f%%; a range when they round differently", 100 * p_f, 100 * p_m))
scP("pct_all_female_r0", p_f, 0); scP("pct_all_male_r0", p_m, 0)
scM("dd_all_female_M", g(s_sex, "dd", int = "All", sex = "Female"), 1)
scM("dd_all_male_M", g(s_sex, "dd", int = "All", sex = "Male"), 1)
p_u70 <- g(s_u70, "pct", int = "All", u70 = TRUE)
scP("pct_all_u70_r0", p_u70, 0); scP("pct_all_o70_r0", g(s_u70, "pct", int = "All", u70 = FALSE), 0)
scM("dd_all_u70_M", g(s_u70, "dd", int = "All", u70 = TRUE), 1)
scM("dd_all_o70_M", g(s_u70, "dd", int = "All", u70 = FALSE), 1)
p_all <- g(s_int, "pct", int = "All")
set_sc("one_in_n_all", 1 / p_all, num_word(round(1 / p_all)))
set_sc("one_in_n_u70", 1 / p_u70, num_word(round(1 / p_u70)))

# regions
for (r in c("ssa", "seao", "sa", "lac", "cee", "name")) scP(paste0("pct_all_reg_", r), reg_pct("All", r), 0)
for (r in c("ssa", "seao", "sa")) scP(paste0("pct_htn_reg_", r), reg_pct("HTN", r), 0)
scP("pct_sodium_reg_seao", reg_pct("Sodium", "seao"), 0); scP("pct_sodium_reg_sa", reg_pct("Sodium", "sa"), 0)
oth <- s_reg[int == "Sodium" & !region %in% region_abbr[c("seao", "sa")]]
set_sc("pct_sodium_reg_other_range", 100 * min(oth$pct), sprintf("%d–%d", floor(100 * min(oth$pct)), ceiling(100 * max(oth$pct))),
       note = sprintf("min %.2f%% (%s), max %.2f%% (%s); floor(min)-ceiling(max)", 100 * min(oth$pct), oth[which.min(pct), region],
                      100 * max(oth$pct), oth[which.max(pct), region]))
for (r in c("lac")) scP(paste0("pct_statins_reg_", r), reg_pct("Statins", r), 0)
for (r in c("name", "sa", "hi", "cee")) scP(paste0("pct_statins_reg_", r), reg_pct("Statins", r), 1)
# Ranked statements in the Results text, checked here so a rerun cannot silently contradict them.
rank_of <- function(i, by_col) { x <- if (by_col == "region") s_reg[int == i] else s_cause[int == i]; x[order(-get(if (by_col == "region") "pct" else "dd")), get(by_col)] }
check(identical(rank_of("All", "cause"), c("ihd", "hstroke", "istroke", "hhd")), "Results: all-intervention cause order changed; revise the text")
check(identical(rank_of("HTN", "cause"), c("ihd", "hstroke", "istroke", "hhd")), "Results: HTN cause order changed; revise the text")
check(identical(rank_of("Sodium", "cause")[1:3], c("hstroke", "ihd", "istroke")), "Results: sodium cause order changed; revise the text")
check(identical(rank_of("All", "region")[1:6], unname(region_abbr[c("ssa", "seao", "sa", "cee", "name", "lac")])), "Results: all-intervention region order changed; revise the text")
check(identical(rank_of("HTN", "region")[1:3], unname(region_abbr[c("ssa", "seao", "sa")])), "Results: HTN top regions changed; revise the text")
check(identical(rank_of("Sodium", "region")[1:2], unname(region_abbr[c("seao", "sa")])), "Results: sodium top regions changed; revise the text")
check(identical(rank_of("Statins", "region")[1:3], unname(region_abbr[c("lac", "name", "cee")])), "Results: statin top regions changed; revise the text")
check(abs(diff(s_sex[int == "Statins", pct])) < 0.001, "Results: statin reductions by sex are no longer similar; revise the text")
check(g(s_loc[int == "All"], "dd", location = "India") / 1e6 < 16.7 && g(s_loc[int == "All"], "dd", location = "India") / 1e6 > 12,
      "Comparison: India is no longer between the Pickersgill and Kontis estimates; revise the text")
check(between(g(s_loc[int == "All"], "dd", location = "Bangladesh") / 1e6, 1.3, 2.0),
      "Comparison: Bangladesh is no longer within the Pickersgill (1.3) - Kontis (2.0) range; revise the text")

# hypertension, sodium, TFA, statins paragraphs
scP("pct_htn", g(s_int, "pct", int = "HTN"), 1)
scM("dd_htn_per_year_M_1d", g(s_int, "per_year", int = "HTN"), 1)
for (cc in c("hstroke", "ihd", "istroke", "hhd")) scM(sprintf("dd_htn_%s_M", cc), g(s_cause, "dd", int = "HTN", cause = cc), 1)
scM("dd_sodium_per_year_M_1d", g(s_int, "per_year", int = "Sodium"), 1)
scP("pct_sodium", g(s_int, "pct", int = "Sodium"), 1)
scM("dd_sodium_ihd_M", g(s_cause, "dd", int = "Sodium", cause = "ihd"), 1)
scM("dd_sodium_istroke_M", g(s_cause, "dd", int = "Sodium", cause = "istroke"), 1)
scM("dd_sodium_hstroke_M", g(s_cause, "dd", int = "Sodium", cause = "hstroke"), 1)
per_year_k <- function(x) round(x / 1e4) * 1e4
set_sc("dd_tfa_per_year_k", g(s_int, "per_year", int = "TFA"), fmt_int(per_year_k(g(s_int, "per_year", int = "TFA"))))
scP("pct_tfa", g(s_int, "pct", int = "TFA"), 1)
scP("pct_tfa_u70_r0", g(s_u70, "pct", int = "TFA", u70 = TRUE), 0)
set_sc("dd_statins_per_year_k", g(s_int, "per_year", int = "Statins"), fmt_int(per_year_k(g(s_int, "per_year", int = "Statins"))))
scP("pct_statins", g(s_int, "pct", int = "Statins"), 1)
scM("dd_statins_ihd_M", g(s_cause, "dd", int = "Statins", cause = "ihd"), 1)
scP("pct_statins_ihd", g(s_cause, "pct", int = "Statins", cause = "ihd"), 1)
scM("dd_statins_istroke_M", g(s_cause, "dd", int = "Statins", cause = "istroke"), 1)
scP("pct_statins_istroke", g(s_cause, "pct", int = "Statins", cause = "istroke"), 1)
scP("pct_statins_u70", g(s_u70, "pct", int = "Statins", u70 = TRUE), 1)
scP("pct_statins_o70", g(s_u70, "pct", int = "Statins", u70 = FALSE), 1)

# candidates printed for the pending TFA items (REPRO_PENDING [Results TFA paragraph] and [Discussion TFA])
tfa_cand <- rbind(
  summ("age_group", ints = "TFA")[, .(estimand = paste("TFA, age", age_group), pct = 100 * pct)],

# Discussion: China sodium
sod_cn <- g(SOD, "sodium_current", location = "China", year = 2025)
pow_cn <- g(POW, "sodium_powles_2010", location = "China")
set_sc("sodium_china_current_g", sod_cn, fmt_num(sod_cn, 2))

scP("sodium_china_share_pct", g(summ("location", ints = "Sodium"), "dd", int = "Sodium", location = "China") / g(s_int, "dd", int = "Sodium"), 0)

# Table 2
```

# 6. Figure 1: deaths delayed over time

Report chunk `output-tsplot`. The areas stack the four separate single-intervention effects; the top of
the stack is their sum, not the simulated combined effect (`All`), and is not rescaled to match it.

```{r fig1}
f1 <- summ("year", ints = int_single)[, .(year, int, dd)]
f1[, intervention := factor(int_label[int], levels = rev(int_label[int_single]))]
setorder(f1, intervention, year)
f1[, cum_dd := cumsum(dd), by = intervention]
PD$fig1 <- f1[, .(year, intervention = as.character(intervention), dd, cum_dd)]
fig1_theme <- theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "horizontal", legend.title = element_text(size = 14, face = "bold"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 12), panel.grid.minor = element_blank())
fig1 <- function(yvar) {
  ggplot(f1, aes(x = year, y = .data[[yvar]], fill = intervention)) +
    geom_area(position = "stack", colour = "grey20", linewidth = 0.2, alpha = 0.8) +
    scale_y_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
    scale_fill_brewer(palette = "Set2") +
    labs(title = "", x = "Year", y = "Deaths Delayed", fill = "") +
    fig1_theme
}
save_fig(fig1("dd"), "fig1a_annual_deaths_delayed.png", 11, 6)
save_fig(fig1("cum_dd"), "fig1b_cumulative_deaths_delayed.png", 11, 6)
```

```{r fig3}
f3 <- summ(c("location", "sex"), ints = "All")[, .(location, sex, pct = 100 * pct)]
f3[CD, iso3 := i.iso3, on = "location"]

}
```

# 9. Figure 4: deaths delayed by sex, age, region and intervention

Report chunk `output-excel` (the `dt_out_5` dot plot saved as `out_deaths_disaggregation_bubble.png`):
single interventions only, by sex, age group and region.

```{r fig4}
f4 <- rbindlist(list(
  summ("sex", ints = int_single)[, .(int, disaggregation = "Sex", factor = sex, dd)],
  summ("age_group", ints = int_single)[, .(int, disaggregation = "Age", factor = age_group, dd)],
  summ("region", ints = int_single)[, .(int, disaggregation = "Region", factor = region, dd)]))
f4[, factor_nested := factor(paste(disaggregation, factor, sep = " • "),
                             levels = c(paste("Sex •", c("Female", "Male")), paste("Age •", age_levels),
                                        paste("Region •", sort(unique(CD$region)))))]
f4[, intervention := factor(int_label[int], levels = sort(int_label[int_single]))]
check(!anyNA(f4$factor_nested), "Figure 4: unexpected factor levels")
PD$fig4 <- f4[, .(intervention = as.character(intervention), disaggregation, factor, dd)]
wrap22 <- function(x) vapply(x, function(s) paste(strwrap(s, 22), collapse = "\n"), "")
g4 <- ggplot(f4, aes(x = dd, y = factor_nested, colour = intervention)) +
  geom_point(alpha = 0.8, size = 4) +
  scale_x_continuous(labels = scales::comma) +
  scale_y_discrete(expand = expansion(mult = c(0.05, 0.15))) +
  scale_colour_discrete(labels = wrap22) +
  labs(x = "Deaths Delayed", y = "", colour = "") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.box = "vertical", legend.key.width = unit(18, "pt"),
        legend.text = element_text(size = 11), plot.margin = margin(20, 30, 80, 20),
        axis.text.y = element_text(margin = margin(r = 5)), panel.grid.major.y = element_line(linewidth = 0.3)) +
  guides(colour = guide_legend(nrow = 2, byrow = TRUE)) +
  coord_cartesian(clip = "off")
save_fig(g4, "fig4_deaths_delayed_sex_age_region.png", 11, 7.5)
```

# 11. Figure S1: risk-factor trajectories

Report chunks `out-policy-bp` (second plot), `out-policy-salt`, `out-policy-tfa-scenarios`,
`out-policy-statins`. Lines are restricted to the 190 modelled countries (the report used all rows of
`HBP`, and filtered sodium/TFA to `covfxn2.csv` names, which dropped 16 modelled countries).

```{r figS1}
theme_s1 <- theme_minimal(base_size = 20) +
  theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold"), axis.title.x = element_text(size = 22, margin = margin(t = 16)),
        axis.title.y = element_text(size = 22, margin = margin(r = 12)), axis.text = element_text(size = 20),
        plot.margin = margin(t = 10, r = 10, b = 30, l = 10))
x_s1 <- scale_x_continuous(breaks = seq(2020, 2050, 5), limits = c(2020, 2051), expand = c(0, 0))
spag <- function(dt, y, title, ylab, ylim = NULL, th = theme_s1) {
  p <- ggplot(dt, aes(x = year, y = .data[[y]], group = location)) +
    geom_line(colour = "grey70", linewidth = 0.8, alpha = 0.7) + x_s1 + labs(title = title, x = "Year", y = ylab) + th
  if (!is.null(ylim)) p <- p + scale_y_continuous(limits = ylim, expand = c(0, 0))
  p
}
s1a <- HBP[location %in% locs][, ctrl := 100 * pmax(control_scaled, baseline_ctrl)]
save_fig(spag(s1a, "ctrl", "Improved Hypertension Control", "Hypertension Control Rate (%)", c(0, 100)), "figS1a_traj_hypertension_control.png", 11, 6)
s1b <- SOD[location %in% locs][, sodium := pmax(sodium_target_asp, 2)]
save_fig(spag(s1b, "sodium", "Population Sodium Reduction", "Mean Sodium Intake in Grams per Day"), "figS1b_traj_sodium.png", 11, 6)
s1c <- TFAS[location %in% locs & year >= 2019][, tfa := 100 * tfa_target]
theme_s1c <- theme_minimal() + theme(plot.title = element_text(size = 28, face = "bold"), axis.title = element_text(size = 22), axis.text = element_text(size = 20))
save_fig(spag(s1c, "tfa", "TFA Elimination", "Mean TFA Intake (%E)", th = theme_s1c), "figS1c_traj_tfa.png", 11, 6)
s1d <- STA[location %in% locs][, statins := 100 * statins_uptake]
save_fig(spag(s1d, "statins", "Improved Statin Uptake", "Risk Population with Statins Therapy (%)", c(0, 100)), "figS1d_traj_statins.png", 11, 6)
```

# 12. Figure S2: required and historical scale-up of hypertension control

Report chunk `out-policy-bp-past` with the repo copy of the NCD-RisC file. The upper panel plots the
required annual increase in percentage points (x 100): the report plotted proportions under a
"pp/year" label.

```{r figS2}
aroc <- NCD[Year == 2019, .(controlled = mean(controlled)), by = .(Country, ISO)]
for (ty in c(2030L, 2040L, 2050L)) aroc[, paste0("y", ty) := 100 * pmax(0, (mp$target_control - controlled) / (ty - yr_impl_start))]
s2a <- melt(aroc, id.vars = c("Country", "ISO"), measure.vars = c("y2030", "y2040", "y2050"), variable.name = "target_year", value.name = "aroc")
s2a[, target_year := sub("^y", "", target_year)]
PD$figS2a <- s2a[, .(ISO, target_year, aroc)]
g_s2a <- ggplot(s2a, aes(x = target_year, y = aroc, fill = target_year)) +

aroc_gt3 <- aroc[y2040 > 3, .N]

ch <- copy(NCD)[order(Country, Sex, Year)]
ch[, `:=`(diagnosed_change = 100 * (diagnosed - shift(diagnosed)), treated_change = 100 * (treated - shift(treated)),
          controlled_change = 100 * (controlled - shift(controlled))), by = .(Country, Sex)]
```

# 13. Figure S3: age-standardised mortality rates

ASMR per 100,000 with the WHO World Standard Population 2000-2025 rescaled to ages 20-95+ (setup chunk).
2000-2018: rates implied by the model inputs (calibrated chunks: GBD 2023 rates x UN-WPP 2024 population,
not simulated); 2019-2050: the model's own deaths and population for each scenario. One population copy
per stratum (the former report chunk divided by population summed over the four cause models). Both sexes:
deaths and population are summed over sex before the age-specific rate is taken.

```{r figS3}
s3_hist <- merge(BR[, .(cvd = sum(Nx * DIS.mx.t0)), by = .(year, age)],
                 BR[cause == cause_map[["ihd"]], .(pop = sum(Nx), other = sum(Nx * BG.mx.all)), by = .(year, age)],
                 by = c("year", "age"))
s3_mod <- merge(ACC$SA[, .(cvd = sum(dead)), by = .(int, year, age)],
                ACC$SP[, .(pop = sum(pop), all_mx = sum(all_mx)), by = .(int, year, age)], by = c("int", "year", "age"))
s3_mod[, other := all_mx - cvd]   # other causes in the model: shared background deaths, incl. COVID-19 excess 2020-2021
check(all(s3_hist$pop > 0) && all(s3_mod$pop > 0) && all(s3_mod$other > -1e-6 * s3_mod$all_mx),
      "Figure S3: non-positive population or negative other-cause deaths")
check(setequal(unique(s3_mod$int), unname(int_raw)), "Figure S3: scenario missing from the single-age sums")
s3_series <- c(cvd = "CVD (four causes)", other = "Other causes")
s3_h <- melt(s3_hist[, .(year, age, cvd = cvd / pop, other = other / pop)], id.vars = c("year", "age"),
             variable.name = "series", value.name = "rate", variable.factor = FALSE)
s3_h <- asmr_of(s3_h, c("year", "series"))
s3_h <- s3_h[, .(int = unname(int_raw)), by = .(year, series, asmr)]
s3_m <- melt(s3_mod[, .(int, year, age, cvd = cvd / pop, other = other / pop)], id.vars = c("int", "year", "age"),
             variable.name = "series", value.name = "rate", variable.factor = FALSE)
s3_m <- asmr_of(s3_m, c("int", "year", "series"))
s3 <- rbind(s3_h, s3_m, use.names = TRUE)
check(nrow(s3[, .N, by = .(int, year, series)][N > 1]) == 0, "Figure S3: duplicated years")
s3[, `:=`(series = s3_series[series], panel = factor(int_label[int], levels = int_label[c("BAU", "HTN", "Sodium", "TFA", "Statins", "All")]))]
PD$figS3 <- s3[, .(int, year, series, asmr)]
g_s3 <- ggplot(s3, aes(x = year, y = asmr, colour = series, group = series)) +
  geom_line(data = s3[year <= 2019], linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(data = s3[year >= 2019], linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~panel, ncol = 3) +
  scale_colour_manual(values = c(`CVD (four causes)` = "steelblue", `Other causes` = "tomato")) +
  labs(x = "Year", y = "Age-standardized mortality rate (per 100,000)", colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", strip.text = element_text(face = "bold", size = 13))
save_fig(g_s3, "figS3_asmr_by_cause.png", 12, 7)
```

# 14. Figure S4 and Validation paragraph

Report chunks `valida-ihme-foresight2` (deaths) and `valida-ihme-foresight` (ASMR index), both rebuilt here.
Foresight files are the repo copies under `data-raw/GBD`; their footer cites GBD 2019 Foresight. These are
forecast-to-forecast comparisons, not validation.

```{r figS4}
cause_code <- setNames(names(cause_map), cause_map)

# Top panel: ASMR indices (each series' own 2019 = 100), both sexes, WHO standard 20-95+ (setup chunk).
#  - this study's Global population rates: observed 2000-2019 and reconciled forecast 2020-2050 (stage 2,
#    the locations in tps_inpt); sexes combined with UN-WPP 2024 populations (ages 95+ pooled into 95)
#  - this study's BAU simulation, 190 countries (deaths / population, one population copy)
#  - GBD 2019 Foresight age-standardised rates, Past + Reference (their own standard; only the index is compared)
need_cols(POP, c("location", "year_id", "sex", "age", "Nx"), "POP")
check(length(setdiff(TRD$meta$locations, unique(POP$location))) == 0, "Figure S4a: forecast locations missing from POP")
s4_pop <- POP[location %in% TRD$meta$locations & age >= 20 & year_id %in% unique(TRC$year)][
  , .(N = sum(Nx)), by = .(sex, age = pmin(as.integer(age), 95L), year = year_id)]
s4_g <- merge(TRC[, .(sex, age, year, cause, rate = DIS.mx.t0)], s4_pop, by = c("sex", "age", "year"))
check(nrow(s4_g) == nrow(TRC), "Figure S4a: population weights do not cover the forecast grid")
s4_g <- asmr_of(s4_g[, .(rate = sum(rate * N) / sum(N)), by = .(cause, age, year)], c("cause", "year"))
s4_b <- merge(ACC$SA[int == "BAU", .(dead = sum(dead)), by = .(cause, age, year)],
              ACC$SP[int == "BAU", .(pop = sum(pop)), by = .(age, year)], by = c("age", "year"))
s4_b <- asmr_of(s4_b[, .(cause, age, year, rate = dead / pop)], c("cause", "year"))
s4_src <- c(g = "This study: Global rates (observed to 2019, reconciled forecast)", b = "This study: BAU simulation",
            f = "GBD 2019 Foresight")
s4a <- rbind(s4_g[, source := s4_src[["g"]]], s4_b[, source := s4_src[["b"]]],
             FORA[year >= 2000, .(cause = cause_code[cause_of_death_or_injury], year, asmr = value, source = s4_src[["f"]])],
             use.names = TRUE)
check(s4a[year == 2019, .N, by = .(source, cause)][, all(N == 1)] && s4a[year == 2019, .N] == 3L * length(cause_map),
      "Figure S4a: each series needs one 2019 value per cause")
s4a[, index := 100 * asmr / asmr[year == 2019], by = .(source, cause)]
s4a[, cause_label := cause_map[cause]]
PD$figS4a <- s4a[, .(year, cause, source, asmr, index)]
g_s4a <- ggplot(s4a, aes(x = year, y = index, colour = source, group = source)) +
  geom_line(data = s4a[year <= 2019], linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(data = s4a[year >= 2019], linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~cause_label, scales = "free_y") +
  labs(title = "ASMR | Global | Both sexes | Ages 20+ years", x = "Year", y = "Age-standardized mortality rate index (2019 = 100)",
       colour = NULL) +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 13) +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", legend.direction = "vertical", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 15))
save_fig(g_s4a, "figS4a_asmr_index_vs_foresight.png", 11, 7)

# Bottom panel: deaths
s4_obs <- BR[, .(deaths = sum(Nx * DIS.mx.t0)), by = .(year, cause = cause_code[cause])]
s4_mod <- B[year >= yr_model_start, .(deaths = sum(bau)), by = .(year, cause)]
s4_for <- FOR[year >= 2000, .(year, cause = cause_code[cause_of_death_or_injury], deaths = value, source = "GBD Foresight")]
s4 <- rbind(s4_obs[, source := src_input], s4_mod[, source := src_bau], s4_for)
s4[, cause_label := cause_map[cause]]
PD$figS4b <- s4[, .(year, cause, source, deaths)]
g_s4b <- ggplot(s4, aes(x = year, y = deaths / 1e6, colour = source, group = source)) +
  geom_line(data = s4[year <= 2019], linetype = "solid", linewidth = 1) +
  geom_line(data = s4[year > 2019], linetype = "dashed", linewidth = 1) +
  facet_wrap(~cause_label, scales = "free_y") +
  theme_minimal(base_size = 14) +
  labs(title = "Deaths| Global | Both sexes | Ages 20+ years", x = "Year", y = "Deaths (Million)", colour = "Source") +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom", plot.title = element_text(face = "bold", size = 16))
save_fig(g_s4b, "figS4b_deaths_vs_foresight.png", 11, 6)

scM("val_bau_2050_M", B[year == 2050, sum(bau)], 0)
scM("val_foresight_2050_M", FOR[year == 2050, sum(value)], 0)
scM("val_unwpp_2050_M", UND[year == 2050, sum(deaths_unwpp)], 1)
scM("val_model_allcause_2050_M", AC[year == 2050, sum(all_mx)], 1)
# Statements in the comparison paragraph of the supplement
check(B[year == 2050, sum(bau)] > FOR[year == 2050, sum(value)], "Supplement: BAU 2050 CVD deaths no longer exceed Foresight; revise the text")
check(abs(AC[year == 2050, sum(all_mx)] / UND[year == 2050, sum(deaths_unwpp)] - 1) < 0.05,
      "Supplement: model all-cause deaths in 2050 are no longer within 5% of UN-WPP; revise 'close to'")
```

# 16. Comparison to previous work: text, Table S2 and Table S3

"This study" columns from the outputs; Kontis et al. 2019 and Pickersgill et al. 2022 values are quoted
from the papers (Kontis country values: Kontis et al. 2019, supplementary table, deaths delayed 2015-2040,
thousands; also in `data-raw/Transversals/kontis-et-al-2019- supplemental.xlsx`); the "Kontis methods"
replication column is preserved (no replication outputs in the repo).

```{r comparison}
# Table S2. Legacy workbook TS2_CompareIntervention!A3:E8. NA = not modelled.
ts2_ext <- data.table(
  int = c("HTN", "Sodium", "TFA", "Statins", "All"),
  kontis_methods = c(40.9, 44, 4.2, 11, 95.3),    # REPRO_PENDING: Kontis-methods replication runs not in the repo
  kontis         = c(39.4, 40, 14.8, NA, 94.3),   # Kontis et al. 2019, 2015-2040
  pickersgill    = c(67.4, 24.1, NA, NA, 88.5))   # Pickersgill et al. 2022, 2022-2050
# Signed value; the display is the absolute difference, with its direction in cmp_*_dir.
cmp_rel <- c(kontis = dd_all / 1e6 / ts2_ext[int == "All", kontis] - 1, pick = dd_all / 1e6 / ts2_ext[int == "All", pickersgill] - 1)
set_sc("cmp_kontis_pct_higher", 100 * cmp_rel[["kontis"]], formatC(abs(100 * cmp_rel[["kontis"]]), format = "f", digits = 0))
set_sc("cmp_pick_pct_higher", 100 * cmp_rel[["pick"]], formatC(abs(100 * cmp_rel[["pick"]]), format = "f", digits = 0))
set_sc("cmp_kontis_dir", sign(cmp_rel[["kontis"]]), if (cmp_rel[["kontis"]] >= 0) "higher" else "lower")
set_sc("cmp_pick_dir", sign(cmp_rel[["pick"]]), if (cmp_rel[["pick"]] >= 0) "higher" else "lower")
s_loc_all <- s_loc[int == "All"]
scM("dd_all_china_M", g(s_loc_all, "dd", location = "China"), 1)
scM("dd_all_india_M", g(s_loc_all, "dd", location = "India"), 1)
scM("dd_all_usa_M", g(s_loc_all, "dd", location = "United States"), 1)
cmp_china <- g(s_loc_all, "dd", location = "China") / 1e6 / 19.1   # Kontis et al. 2019 suppl., China
set_sc("cmp_china_kontis_ratio", cmp_china, formatC(cmp_china, format = "f", digits = 1))
ts2 <- copy(ts2_ext)[s_int, this_study := i.dd / 1e6, on = "int"]
ts2_csv <- ts2[, .(Intervention = int_label[int], `This study (2026–2050)` = this_study,
                   `This study – Kontis methods (2026–2050)` = kontis_methods,
                   `Kontis et al. (2015–2040)` = kontis, `Pickersgill et al. (2022–2050)` = pickersgill)]
comp_names <- function(first) c(first, "This study 2026–2050", "This study – Kontis methods 2026–2050",
                                "Kontis et al. 2015–2040", "Pickersgill et al. 2022–2050")
comp_disp <- function(dt, first) setnames(data.frame(dt[[1]], lapply(dt[, -1], fmt_num, d = 1), check.names = FALSE), comp_names(first))
comp_status <- function(n) matrix(rep(c("static_content", "reproduced", "preserved_pending", "fixed_external", "fixed_external"), each = n), n, 5)
add_table("TS2_CompareIntervention", ts2_csv, comp_disp(ts2_csv, "Intervention"), comp_status(nrow(ts2_csv)),
          bold = which(ts2_csv$Intervention == "All Interventions"), numfmt = setNames(rep("0.0", 4), names(ts2_csv)[-1]))

# Table S3. Legacy workbook TS3_CompareCountry!A3:E18 (the 15 countries and order follow Kontis et al.).
ts3_ext <- data.table(
  location = c("China", "India", "Indonesia", "Russian Federation", "United States", "Pakistan", "Brazil", "Bangladesh",
               "Egypt", "Japan", "Philippines", "Ukraine", "Nigeria", "Mexico", "Myanmar"),
  kontis_methods = c(30.6, 13.6, 6.9, 3.8, 1.1, 2.7, 1.5, 2, 1.5, 1, 1.6, 1.3, 1.7, 0.8, 1.6),  # REPRO_PENDING (replication runs)
  kontis         = c(19.1, 16.7, 4, 4, 3.7, 3.1, 2.7, 2, 2.5, 1.4, 1.3, 1.6, 1.2, 1.3, 1.1),     # Kontis et al. 2019 suppl.
  pickersgill    = c(27, 12, 3.7, 2.7, 0.4, 1.6, 0.9, 1.3, 1.2, 0.8, 1.1, 0.9, 1.5, 0.6, 0.8))  # Pickersgill et al. 2022
check(all(ts3_ext$location %in% locs), "Table S3 countries missing from the model outputs")
ts3 <- copy(ts3_ext)[s_loc_all, this_study := i.dd / 1e6, on = "location"]
ts3_csv <- ts3[, .(Country = location, `This study (2026–2050)` = this_study,
                   `This study – Kontis methods (2026–2050)` = kontis_methods,
                   `Kontis et al. (2015–2040)` = kontis, `Pickersgill et al. (2022–2050)` = pickersgill)]
add_table("TS3_CompareCountry", ts3_csv, comp_disp(ts3_csv, "Country"), comp_status(nrow(ts3_csv)),
          numfmt = setNames(rep("0.0", 4), names(ts3_csv)[-1]))
ts3_top15 <- s_loc_all[order(-dd)][1:15, location]
```

```{r tableS4}
ts4 <- data.table(
  Dimension = c("Modeling Approach", "Diseases Modeled (BP/Sodium)", "Business-as-Usual Scenario", "BP Risk Modeling",
                "Hypertension Treatment Mechanism", "Treatment Effect Application", "Time Lag for BP Effects",
                "Sodium Input & Units", "Sodium to SBP Mapping", "Sodium Effect Application", "Trans Fat (TFA) Target",
                "TFA Effect Size", "Statins Scope", "Pros", "Cons"),
  `This Study (Model A)` = c(
    "Uses discrete BP categories with probability distributions; incidence is recalculated from GBD relative risks and Ettehad-based treatment effects; case fatality is modified separately.",
    "IHD, ischemic stroke, hemorrhagic stroke, hypertensive heart disease; sodium reductions apply to the same CVD outcomes.",
    "Includes background mortality improvements, age–sex–cause secular trends, and updated UN-WPP demographic changes.",
    "Uses GBD relative risks by BP category, normalized to distribute baseline incidence across categories; trial effect sizes modify each category’s incidence.",
    "Increases the share of individuals in controlled BP categories by scaling incremental coverage above baseline; applies category-specific trial effect sizes to incidence and CF.",
    "Lowers disease incidence (via trial-based category-specific incidence reductions) and lowers case fatality.",
    "No explicit lag; changes evolve annually via linear scale-up trajectories.",
    "Accepts sodium or salt; converts automatically; supports target or percent reductions.",
    "Uses Filippini coefficients: 2.8 mmHg per gram for raised BP, 1.0 mmHg for normotensive, scaled by population distribution.",
    "Reduces incidence via SBP trials mapping; no effect on case fatality.",
    "Eliminates industrial TFA to 0% energy; applies to IHD case fatality.",
    "Applies to adults 40+ with IHD or ischemic stroke; reduces both incidence and case fatality using formulas.",
    "Uses discrete blood pressure (BP) categories with probability distributions; incidence is recalculated from GBD relative risks and trial-based treatment effects; case fatality is modified separately.",
    "IHD, ischemic stroke, hemorrhagic stroke, hypertensive heart disease; sodium reductions apply to the same CVD outcomes.",
    "Includes background mortality improvements, age–sex–cause secular trends, and updated UN-WPP demographic changes."),
  `Kontis et al. 2019 (Model B)` = c(
    "Uses average SBP and age-specific risk relationships; calculates impact of sodium on SBP, then on disease risk.",
    "Includes all this study diseases plus CKD, stomach cancer, and other CVDs.", "No built-in improvements.",
    "Uses age-specific risk per unit SBP increase.", "Reduces average SBP by a fixed amount in treated individuals.",
    "Affects only cause-specific mortality rates.", "Includes up to 10-year lag with linear ramp.", "Uses sodium directly.",
    "Uses fixed mmHg reductions from meta-analysis.", "Reduces mortality via SBP and risk mapping.", "0.5% of energy intake.",
    "Same formula applied to IHD mortality.", "Not included.",
    "Simple and clean continuous modeling; includes time lags and optimal SBP floors.",
    "Only affects mortality, possibly underestimating prevention benefits."),
  `Key Differences / Notes` = c(
    "Model A uses categorical BP levels; Model B uses continuous SBP values.", "Model B covers more conditions.",
    "Model A accounts for secular trends; Model B does not.", "Model A is categorical; Model B is continuous.",
    "Model A redistributes categories; Model B lowers SBP directly.", "Model A explicitly considers the impact of preventing CVD.",
    "Lag handling differs.", "Both converge to salt; Model A allows unit switching.",
    "Model B uses standardized anchors; Model A uses custom coefficients.", "Model A focuses on prevention; Model B on mortality reduction.",
    "Different policy targets, same methods", "Identical math; only targets differ.", "Model A includes statins; Model B does not.",
    "Each model suits different policy needs/asesments.", "Trade-offs in scope and realism."))
add_table("TS4_ModelCompare", ts4, ts4, "static_content")
```

# 18. Tables S5, S6 and S7

Report block `ADD: <70 outputs` and chunk `out-tab-loc`. Table S5 and S6 percentages follow their notes:
deaths delayed before age 70 / all deaths delayed for that intervention and sex (S5) or country (S6).
Table S6 selects the 30 countries with the largest BAU adult population (20-95, one cause copy) in 2025
and keeps the legacy row order (deaths delayed <70, descending).

```{r tablesS5-S7}
s_sexu70 <- summ(c("sex", "u70"))
ts5 <- CJ(sex = c("Female", "Male"), int = int_table, sorted = FALSE)
ts5[, dd_u70 := mapply(function(s, i) g(s_sexu70, "dd", sex = s, int = i, u70 = TRUE), sex, int)]
ts5[, dd_all := mapply(function(s, i) g(s_sex, "dd", sex = s, int = i), sex, int)]
ts5[, share_u70 := dd_u70 / dd_all]
ts5_csv <- ts5[, .(Intervention = int_label[int], Sex = sex, `Deaths Delayed (#)` = dd_u70, `Deaths Delayed (<70 years %)` = share_u70)]
ts5_disp <- data.frame(Intervention = ts5_csv$Intervention, Sex = blank_repeats(ts5_csv$Sex),
                       "Deaths Delayed (#)" = fmt_int(ts5_csv$`Deaths Delayed (#)`),
                       "Deaths Delayed (<70 years %)" = fmt_pct(ts5_csv$`Deaths Delayed (<70 years %)`, 1), check.names = FALSE)
add_table("TS5_Premature_Sex", ts5_csv, ts5_disp, "reproduced", bold = which(ts5_csv$Intervention == "All Interventions"),
          numfmt = c(`Deaths Delayed (#)` = "#,##0", `Deaths Delayed (<70 years %)` = "0.0%"))

pop25 <- AC[year == 2025, .(population = sum(pop)), by = location][order(-population)]
top30 <- pop25[1:30, location]
s_locu70 <- summ(c("location", "u70"), ints = "All")
ts6 <- s_locu70[location %in% top30, .(dd_u70 = sum(dd[u70]), dd_all = sum(dd)), by = location][, share := dd_u70 / dd_all][order(-dd_u70)]
ts6_csv <- ts6[, .(Location = location, `Projected Deaths Delayed <70 years` = dd_u70, `Share of delayed deaths occurring <70 years (%)` = share)]
ts6_disp <- data.frame(Location = ts6_csv$Location, "Projected Deaths Delayed <70 years" = fmt_int(ts6_csv[[2]]),
                       "Share of delayed deaths occurring <70 years (%)" = fmt_pct(ts6_csv[[3]], 1), check.names = FALSE)
add_table("TS6_Premature_Top30", ts6_csv, ts6_disp, "reproduced",
          numfmt = c(`Projected Deaths Delayed <70 years` = "#,##0", `Share of delayed deaths occurring <70 years (%)` = "0.0%"))

ts7 <- s_loc_all[order(region, location)]
ts7_csv <- ts7[, .(Location = location, Region = region, `Projected Deaths` = proj, `Baseline Deaths` = bau,
                   `Deaths Delayed` = dd, `Deaths Delayed per Year` = per_year, `% Delayed` = pct)]
ts7_disp <- ts7_csv[, .(Location, `Projected Deaths` = fmt_int(`Projected Deaths`), `Baseline Deaths` = fmt_int(`Baseline Deaths`),
                        `Deaths Delayed` = fmt_int(`Deaths Delayed`), `Deaths Delayed per Year` = fmt_int(`Deaths Delayed per Year`),
                        `% Delayed` = fmt_pct(`% Delayed`, 0))]
add_table("TS7_ByCountry", ts7_csv, ts7_disp, "reproduced",
          numfmt = c(`Projected Deaths` = "#,##0", `Baseline Deaths` = "#,##0", `Deaths Delayed` = "#,##0",
                     `Deaths Delayed per Year` = "#,##0", `% Delayed` = "0%"))
```
