# 19. Table S8 and the Sensitivity analysis paragraph

Four mortality-trend blocks (setup chunk, `s8_dsa`), each summed over W for the five reported
interventions against its own BAU, from unrounded values: deaths delayed = BAU − intervention deaths,
% = deaths delayed / BAU, per year = deaths delayed / `r length(win_cum)` (the inclusive window). Base case:
the main results above (production run, `MRM`). Alternatives: the stage-8 runs, read with the same reader
(`read_model_file`) and summary (`summ`) as the main results after their provenance is checked against the
base case. The combined row is the simulated `all_four` scenario, never a sum of single effects.

```{r tableS8}
check(identical(MRM$baseline$trend_method, "coherent"), "Table S8: the base case must be the coherent-trend run")
s8_sum <- list(base = summ()); s8_man <- list(); s8_files <- list(); s8_log <- list()
md5_now <- function(t) identical(unname(tools::md5sum(file.path(root, t$file))), t$md5)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(s8_dsa))) {
  d <- s8_dsa[i]; b <- d$block
  mf <- file.path(d$dir, "dsa_manifest.rds")
  check(file.exists(mf), sprintf("Table S8: no stage-8 output for '%s' (%s is missing); run: Rscript \"code/0. master.R\" 8 \"--dsa=%s\"", b, mf, b))
  M <- readRDS(mf)
  check(identical(M$analysis, b) && identical(M$status, "complete") && !isTRUE(M$pilot) && all(M$validation$checks$passed),
        sprintf("Table S8: stage-8 run '%s' is not a complete, validated run (status: %s)", b, M$status))
  sw_names <- c("mortality_trend_method", "run_bgmx_trend", "run_CF_trend", "run_CF_trend_80", "run_CF_trend_ihme")
  sw <- setNames(lapply(sw_names, function(v) d[[v]]), sw_names)
  check(identical(M$switches[names(sw)], sw), sprintf("Table S8: '%s' ran with switches that differ from its Table S8 definition", b))
  check(identical(M$trend_config$method, d$mortality_trend_method) && identical(M$trend_config$cf_share, if (d$run_CF_trend_80) 0.8 else 1) &&
          identical(M$baseline$trend_method, d$mortality_trend_method) && identical(M$baseline$cf_share, M$trend_config$cf_share),
        sprintf("Table S8: trend_config or the stage-6 baseline of '%s' is not synchronised with its switches", b))
  # Same calibration, runner, base-case run, inputs, countries and window as the main results
  check(identical(M$calibration_run_id, CALS$run_id) && identical(M$baseline$calibration_run_id, CALS$run_id),
        sprintf("Table S8: '%s' used calibration %s, not %s", b, M$calibration_run_id, CALS$run_id))
  check(identical(M$runner_md5, MRM$runner_md5), sprintf("Table S8: '%s' used a different stage-7 runner from the base case", b))
  check(identical(M$production$run_id, MRM$run_id) && isTRUE(M$production$same_runner) && length(M$production$inputs_newer) == 0,
        sprintf("Table S8: '%s' was not run against the base-case run %s with unchanged inputs", b, MRM$run_id))
  check(md5_now(M$input_files) && md5_now(M$trend_files), sprintf("Table S8: inputs or trend files changed after stage-8 run '%s'", b))
  check(identical(as.integer(M$reporting_window), win_cum), sprintf("Table S8: '%s' records a different reporting window", b))
  check(setequal(M$expected_countries, locs), sprintf("Table S8: '%s' covers different countries from the main results", b))
  f <- sort(list.files(file.path(d$dir, "out_model"), pattern = "^model_output_part_.+\\.rds$", full.names = TRUE))
  check(setequal(basename(f), M$files$file) && all(M$files$written_this_run) &&
          identical(unname(tools::md5sum(f)), M$files[match(basename(f), file), md5]),
        sprintf("Table S8: country files of '%s' differ from those its run wrote", b))
  # Same reader and summary as the main results. The coherent blocks keep the strict shared-population check;
  # the independent LC block (accounting not maintained, see read_model_file) gets a bounded one below.
  shared <- d$mortality_trend_method == "coherent"
  r  <- lapply(f, read_model_file, acc = FALSE, shared_pop = shared)
  lg <- rbindlist(lapply(r, `[[`, "LOG"))
  check(shared || (max(lg$pop_spread) < 1e-3 && max(lg$allmx_spread) < 1e-2),
        sprintf("Table S8: in '%s' the cause models' populations differ by more than 0.1%% (or deaths by more than 1%%)", b))
  BB <- rbindlist(lapply(r, `[[`, "B"))[location %in% locs]
  DD <- rbindlist(lapply(r, `[[`, "D"))[location %in% locs]
  PP <- rbindlist(lapply(r, `[[`, "PJ"))[location %in% locs]
  check(setequal(unique(BB$location), locs) && nrow(DD[!BB, on = .(location, cause, sex, age_group, year)]) == 0,
        sprintf("Table S8: '%s' deaths-delayed strata without a BAU match, or countries missing", b))
  check(DD[year < yr_impl_start, sum(abs(dd))] < 1e-6 && all(is.finite(BB$bau)) && all(is.finite(DD$dd)),
        sprintf("Table S8: '%s' has deaths delayed before %d or non-finite aggregates", b, yr_impl_start))
  s <- summ(BB = BB, DD = DD)
  pj <- merge(PP[, .(proj_direct = sum(proj_direct), bau_missing = sum(bau_missing)), by = int], s[, .(int, proj)], by = "int")
  check(nrow(pj) == length(int_table) && pj[, max(abs(proj_direct + bau_missing - proj) / proj)] < 1e-9,
        sprintf("Table S8: projected deaths of '%s' do not reconcile with BAU - deaths delayed", b))
  s8_sum[[b]] <- s; s8_man[[b]] <- M; s8_files[[b]] <- f; s8_log[[b]] <- lg
  rm(r, BB, DD, PP, lg); invisible(gc())
}
# Inputs that no trend switch touches (populations, prevalence, historical rates, BP and coverage data)
# are identical across the stage-8 runs; IR is never trended (only lowered by the probability guard).
s8_inv <- rbindlist(lapply(s8_man, function(M) as.data.table(M$invariant[c("nontrend_columns", "historical_rows", "data_in", "inc",
                                                                           "ir_projection_raised")])), idcol = "block")
check(all(vapply(s8_inv[, !c("block")], uniqueN, 1L) == 1L) && all(s8_inv$ir_projection_raised == 0),
      "Table S8: the stage-8 runs differ in inputs that no trend switch touches")
# The Foresight CF alternative uses the same GBD 2019 Foresight files as Figure S4
fs <- s8_man$ihme_foresight$foresight
check(identical(fs$release, "Global Burden of Disease (GBD) Study 2019") &&
        setequal(fs$files$md5, unname(tools::md5sum(in_files$FORA))), "Table S8: the Foresight CF run used other Foresight files or release")

s8_lab <- c(base = sprintf("Coherent trends; CF %d%% of the cause trend (base case)", round(100 * MRM$baseline$cf_share)),
            setNames(s8_dsa$label, s8_dsa$block))
s8 <- rbindlist(s8_sum, idcol = "block")
ts8 <- s8[CJ(block = names(s8_lab), int = s8_int, sorted = FALSE), on = .(block, int)]
check(nrow(ts8) == length(s8_lab) * length(s8_int) && !anyNA(ts8$dd), "Table S8: rows missing")
# Base block = the main results to full precision; one BAU per block; row identities on unrounded values
check(isTRUE(all.equal(ts8[block == "base"][order(int), .(int, bau, dd, proj, pct, per_year)],
                       s_int[order(int), .(int, bau, dd, proj, pct, per_year)], tolerance = 0, check.attributes = FALSE)),
      "Table S8: base rows differ from the main results")
check(ts8[, uniqueN(bau), by = block][, all(V1 == 1L)], "Table S8: more than one BAU in a block")
check(n_impl_years == length(win_cum) && ts8[, max(abs(bau - dd - proj) / bau)] < 1e-12 &&
        ts8[, max(abs(pct - dd / bau))] < 1e-12 && ts8[, max(abs(per_year - dd / length(win_cum)) / pmax(abs(dd), 1))] < 1e-12,
      "Table S8: a row breaks DD = BAU - projected, % = DD / BAU or per year = DD / 25")

ts8_csv <- ts8[, .(`Mortality Trend Modeling` = s8_lab[block], Intervention = int_label[int], `Projected Deaths (M)` = proj / 1e6,
                   `Baseline Deaths (M)` = bau / 1e6, `Deaths Delayed (M)` = dd / 1e6, `Deaths Delayed per Year (M)` = per_year / 1e6,
                   `Deaths Delayed (%)` = pct)]
ts8_disp <- data.frame("Mortality Trend Modeling" = esc_md(blank_repeats(ts8_csv[[1]])), Intervention = ts8_csv$Intervention,
                       "Projected Deaths" = fmt_num(ts8_csv[[3]], 1), "Baseline Deaths" = ifelse(duplicated(ts8_csv[[1]]), "", fmt_num(ts8_csv[[4]], 1)),
                       "Deaths Delayed" = fmt_num(ts8_csv[[5]], 1), "Deaths Delayed per Year" = fmt_num(ts8_csv[[6]], 1),
                       "Deaths Delayed (%)" = fmt_num(100 * ts8_csv[[7]], 1), check.names = FALSE)
add_table("TS8_Sensitivity", ts8_csv, ts8_disp, "reproduced",
          numfmt = c(`Projected Deaths (M)` = "0.0", `Baseline Deaths (M)` = "0.0", `Deaths Delayed (M)` = "0.0",
                     `Deaths Delayed per Year (M)` = "0.0", `Deaths Delayed (%)` = "0.0%"))

# Sensitivity scalars (Results text): the All rows of Table S8
s8_all <- function(b, col) g(ts8, col, block = b, int = "All")
sens_key <- c(no_trend = "no_trends", lc = "lc", foresight = "ihme_foresight")
for (k in names(sens_key)) {
  scM(sprintf("sens_%s_dd_M", k), s8_all(sens_key[[k]], "dd"), 1)
  scP(sprintf("sens_%s_pct", k), s8_all(sens_key[[k]], "pct"), 1)
  scM(sprintf("sens_%s_bau_M", k), s8_all(sens_key[[k]], "bau"), 1)
}
s8_alls <- ts8[int == "All"]
set_sc("sens_pct_range", 100 * min(s8_alls$pct),
       sprintf("%s%%–%s%%", fmt_num(100 * min(s8_alls$pct), 1), fmt_num(100 * max(s8_alls$pct), 1)),
       note = paste(sprintf("%s %.3f%%", s8_alls$block, 100 * s8_alls$pct), collapse = "; "))
set_sc("sens_dd_range_M", min(s8_alls$dd) / 1e6,
       sprintf("%s–%s", fmt_num(min(s8_alls$dd) / 1e6, 1), fmt_num(max(s8_alls$dd) / 1e6, 1)),
       note = paste(sprintf("%s %.3fM", s8_alls$block, s8_alls$dd / 1e6), collapse = "; "))
# Claims in the Results sensitivity paragraph: across the four blocks the combined deaths delayed rank with the
# BAU deaths, and the relative reduction varies by less than one percentage point ("varied little").
check(identical(order(s8_alls$bau), order(s8_alls$dd)),
      "Results sensitivity text: deaths delayed no longer rank with BAU deaths across the trend blocks; revise the text")
check(diff(range(s8_alls$pct)) < 0.01,
      "Results sensitivity text: relative reductions now differ by 1 percentage point or more; revise 'varied little'")

s8_prov <- rbindlist(lapply(names(s8_man), function(b) {
  M <- s8_man[[b]]
  data.table(block = b, run_id = M$run_id, completed = M$completed, method = M$switches$mortality_trend_method,
             cf_share = M$trend_config$cf_share, cf_source = M$baseline$cf_source, baseline_id = M$baseline$baseline_id,
             calibration = M$calibration_run_id, files = nrow(M$files), nonfinite_rows = sum(M$validation$file_log$nonfinite_rows),
             accounting_breaks_before_guard = M$baseline$accounting_before_guard$n_total_gap, stage7_min = round(M$stage7_minutes, 1),
             max_pop_spread_pct = signif(100 * max(s8_log[[b]]$pop_spread), 3), max_allmx_spread_pct = signif(100 * max(s8_log[[b]]$allmx_spread), 3))
}))
set_sc("sens_lc_pop_spread_pct", 100 * max(s8_log$lc$pop_spread), formatC(100 * max(s8_log$lc$pop_spread), format = "f", digits = 2),
       note = sprintf("country with the largest spread: %s; all-cause deaths spread max %.3f%%", s8_log$lc[which.max(pop_spread), location],
                      100 * max(s8_log$lc$allmx_spread)))
knitr::kable(s8_prov, caption = "Stage-8 sensitivity runs read for Table S8 (provenance checked above)")
knitr::kable(ts8[, .(block, int, bau_M = round(bau / 1e6, 2), dd_M = round(dd / 1e6, 2), pct = round(100 * pct, 2))],
             caption = sprintf("Table S8 values, %d-%d (unrounded values are in the CSV)", min(win_cum), max(win_cum)))
```

# 20. Table S9 and the math-supplement tables (static) with a check against the model code

Table S9: legacy workbook `TS9_Assumptions!A3:C8`. The five math pipe tables stay inline in the
manuscript (so the LaTeX renders); their text is copied verbatim below, exported to CSV and checked
against the constants in `code/7. model_100_multiplicative_func_new3_gbd23_noaroc.R`.

```{r tableS9-math}
ts9 <- data.table(
  Domain = c("(i) Memoryless Property & Tunnel States", "(ii) Stratification by Age, Sex, Time", "(iii) Competing Risks Handling",
             "(iv) Dependence and Independence Assumptions", "(v) Rationale for Multiplicative Combination of Effects"),
  Assumption = c("Models are memoryless; no tunnel states used.",
                 "Models stratified by single-year age groups (20–95+), sex (female/male), and calendar year (2019–2050).",
                 "Cause-specific Markov models with parallel runs; deaths from other causes modeled after cause-specific.",
                 "Interventions modeled as independent.",
                 "Combined intervention effects are calculated multiplicatively across risk pathways."),
  `Rationale / Notes` = c(
    "Each individual’s transition depends only on their current state (Markov assumption). Transition probabilities are updated annually by age and risk exposure, implicitly accounting for time-varying hazards.",
    "Age- and sex-specific risk and mortality rates vary significantly across causes. Temporal stratification allows modeling secular trends and intervention scale-up.",
    "For each cause (IHD, ischemic stroke, hemorrhagic stroke, hypertensive heart disease), we simulate transitions including cause-specific mortality and 'other-cause death' as competing absorbing states. Final cause-of-death aggregation is mutually exclusive.",
    "Assumes conditional independence among risk–disease pathways.",
    "Consistent with standard epidemiologic formulation of IR/CF ratios under multiplicative risk assumptions. Avoids overestimating combined effect size vs. additive assumptions; conservative in presence of overlapping risk reductions."))
add_table("TS9_Assumptions", ts9, ts9, "static_content")

# Math-supplement pipe tables, verbatim from manuscript/manuscript-100mlives2.Rmd (captions kept there).
math_md <- list(
  Math_CF_ReductionFactors = list(caption = "Case fatality reduction factors per unit control", md = r"---(
| Cause | CF Reduction Factor ($\rho_{CF}$) |
|-------|-----------------------------------|
| IHD | 0.24 |
| Ischemic stroke | 0.36 |
| Hemorrhagic stroke | 0.76 |
| HHD | 0.20 |
)---"),
  Math_TFA_RR = list(caption = "Age-specific relative risks for trans fat intake", md = r"---(
| Age Group | RR per 1% |
|-----------|-----------|
| 20-24 | 1.21 |
| 25-29 | 1.20 |
| 30-34 | 1.19 |
| 35-39 | 1.18 |
| 40-44 | 1.17 |
| 45-49 | 1.16 |
| 50-54 | 1.15 |
| 55-59 | 1.14 |
| 60-64 | 1.13 |
| 65-69 | 1.11 |
| 70-74 | 1.10 |
| 75-79 | 1.09 |
| 80+ | 1.07 |
)---"),
  Math_Statin_RR = list(caption = "Statin relative risks used in the model", md = r"---(
| Outcome | RR (Incidence) | RR (Case Fatality) |
|---------|----------------|---------------------|
| IHD | 0.74 | 0.80 |
| Ischemic stroke | 0.80 | 0.96 |
)---"),
  Math_TransitionRates = list(caption = "Annual transition rates in the multi-state model", md = r"---(
| Transition | Rate |
|------------|------|
| Well → Sick | $IR_{\text{new}}(a,s,c,t) = IR(a,s,c,t) \times \varepsilon_{IR}$ |
| Sick → Dead (disease) | $CF_{\text{new}}(a,s,c,t) = CF(a,s,c,t) \times \varepsilon_{CF}$ |
| Well → Dead (background) | $BG.mx(a,s,c,t)$ |
| Sick → Dead (background) | $BG.mx(a,s,c,t)$ |
| All → Dead (COVID-19) | $covid.mx(a,s,t)$ (2020-2021 only) |
)---"),
  Math_Notation = list(caption = "Comprehensive mathematical notation for all model components", md = r"---(
| Symbol | Description |
|--------|-------------|
| *Core Variables* | |
| $a, s, c, t, \ell$ | Age, sex, cause, time (year), location |
| $\text{BP}_{\text{cat}}$ | Blood pressure category |
| $IR_{\text{original}}, CF_{\text{original}}$ | Baseline -Business as usual- incidence rate and case fatality rate (inputs to the transition model) |
| $IR_{\text{new}}, CF_{\text{new}}$ | Post-intervention incidence rate and case fatality rate |
| $W, K, D$ | Well, sick, dead populations |
| $N$ | Total population |
| *Antihypertensive Therapy (BP Control)* | |
| $C_{\text{baseline}}, C_{\text{target}}$ | Baseline and target hypertension control rates |
| $C_0, C_t$ | Baseline coverage and coverage at time $t$ |
| $\Delta C_{\text{target}}$ | Total required incremental change to reach target |
| $\Delta C_{\text{increment}}$ | Time-varying annual incremental coverage (scale-up path) |
| $\Delta C_{\text{delta}}$ | Coverage delta at time $t$ ($C_t - C_0$) |
| $C_{\text{agg}}^{\Delta}$ | Aggregate incremental coverage for modifying CF |
| $P(\text{BP}_{\text{cat}})$ | Distribution of population across BP categories |
| $w_{\text{DM}}$ | Diabetes prevalence weight applied to Ettehad effects |
| $E_{\text{trial}}$ | Ettehad effect size per 10 mmHg SBP reduction |
| $RR_{\text{GBD}}$ | GBD relative risk per 10 mmHg SBP increase |
| $\alpha_{\text{inc}}$ | Incidence normalization factor to anchor baseline IR |
| $\rho_{CF}$ | Case-fatality reduction factor per unit coverage gained |
| $\varepsilon_{IR,\text{BP}}, \varepsilon_{CF,\text{BP}}$ | BP-control effect ratios applied to $IR_{\text{original}}$ and $CF_{\text{original}}$ |
| $T_{\text{start}}, T_{\text{end}}$ | Scale-up start and end years |
| $\Delta SBP_{\text{treated}}$ | Expected SBP reduction among newly controlled hypertensives |
| $f_{\text{scale}}(t)$ | Generic scale-up function mapping $t$ to $C_t$ |
| *Sodium Reduction* | |
| $S_{\text{current}}, S_{\text{target}}$ | Current and target sodium intake (g/day) |
| $S_{\text{eff}}$ | Sodium reduction parameter |
| $S_{\text{reduction}}$ | Time-varying sodium reduction |
| $\Delta SBP$ | Blood pressure reduction from sodium |
| $\phi_{\text{hyp}}$ | Proportion with raised BP |
| $T_{\text{salt,start}}, T_{\text{salt,end}}$ | Sodium intervention start and end years |
| $E^{IR}_{\text{sodium}}$ | Sodium-mediated intermediate proportional reduction in incidence (BP-bin specific, if indexed) |
| $\varepsilon_{IR,\text{sodium}}$ | Sodium incidence effect ratio passed to the transition model |
| $\varepsilon_{CF,\text{sodium}}$ | Sodium case-fatality effect ratio (set to 1 in this model) |
| *Trans Fat Policy* | |
| $TFA_{\text{current}}, TFA_{\text{target}}$ | Current and target trans fat intake (% energy) |
| $\Delta TFA$ | Trans fat reduction |
| $RR_{\text{TFA}}$ | Age-specific RR per 1% trans fat |
| $E_{\text{TFA}}$ | TFA intermediate proportional reduction in IHD case fatality |
| $T_{\text{TFA,start}}$ | TFA policy start year |
| $\varepsilon_{IR,\text{TFA}}$ | TFA incidence effect ratio (set to 1 in this model) |
| $\varepsilon_{CF,\text{TFA}}$ | TFA case-fatality effect ratio (IHD only; 1 otherwise) |
| *Statin Therapy* | |
| $U_{0,\ell}$ | Baseline statin coverage at $T_{\text{stat,start}}$ (coverage already in place) |
| $U_{\text{target}}$ | Target total statin coverage by $T_{\text{stat,end}}$ |
| $\Delta U(t,\ell)$ | Incremental statin coverage above baseline at time $t$ |
| $T_{\text{stat,start}}, T_{\text{stat,end}}$ | Statin scale-up start and end years |
| $\alpha_{IR}, \alpha_{CF}$ | Adherence for incidence (primary) and case fatality (secondary) effects |
| $AF_{c,\ell}$ | Cause- and location-specific attributable fraction (used for incidence only) |
| $\psi_{\text{athero}}$ | Proportion of ischemic stroke that is atherosclerotic (applies to CF only) |
| $RR^{IR}_{c}, RR^{CF}_{c}$ | Trial-based relative risks for incidence and case fatality |
| $\delta^{IR}_{c}, \delta^{CF}_{c}$ | Risk reductions $=1-RR$ for incidence and case fatality |
| $E^{IR}_{c,\ell}(t), E^{CF}_{c,\ell}(t)$ | Incremental effect sizes applied to $IR$ and $CF$ (baseline-adjusted denominators) |
| $\varepsilon_{IR,\text{statin}}, \varepsilon_{CF,\text{statin}}$ | Statin effect ratios passed to the transition model |
| *Combined Effects* | |
| $\varepsilon_{IR,j}, \varepsilon_{CF,j}$ | Generic effect ratios for intervention $j\in\{\text{BP},\text{sodium},\text{TFA},\text{statin}\}$ |
| $\varepsilon_{IR,\text{total}}, \varepsilon_{CF,\text{total}}$ | Combined effect ratios (multiplicative across interventions) |
| *State Transition Model* | |
| $BG.mx, BG.mx.all$ | Background mortality (cause-specific, all-cause) |
| $covid.mx$ | COVID-19 mortality (2020--2021) |
| $\text{PREV}$ | Baseline disease prevalence |
| $\text{DIS.mx}$ | Baseline disease mortality |
| $\text{ALL.mx}$ | All-cause mortality |
)---"))
parse_pipe <- function(md) {
  ln <- trimws(strsplit(trimws(md), "\n", fixed = TRUE)[[1]])
  ln <- ln[!grepl("^\\|[-: |]+\\|$", ln)]
  cells <- lapply(ln, function(l) trimws(strsplit(sub("^\\|", "", sub("\\|$", "", l)), "|", fixed = TRUE)[[1]]))
  k <- length(cells[[1]])
  body <- lapply(cells[-1], function(r) { length(r) <- k; r[is.na(r)] <- ""; r })
  setnames(as.data.table(do.call(rbind, body)), cells[[1]])
}
math_tab <- lapply(math_md, function(m) parse_pipe(m$md))
# the verbatim copies must still match the manuscript's inline tables
ms_txt <- paste(readLines(rp("manuscript", "manuscript-100mlives2.Rmd"), warn = FALSE, encoding = "UTF-8"), collapse = "\n")

# Projection-preparation constants (COVID cap) now live in stage 6 (code/6. build_baseline.R), read as text.
bl_txt <- readLines(in_files$BL, warn = FALSE)
bl_num <- function(pattern) {
  hit <- regmatches(bl_txt, regexpr(pattern, bl_txt, perl = TRUE))
  check(length(hit) >= 1, paste("stage-6 constant not found:", pattern))
  as.numeric(sub(pattern, "\\1", hit[length(hit)], perl = TRUE))
}
```

# 21. Calibration methods and in-sample performance: Table S10, Figure S6, Methods numbers

Reads the saved stage-5 results only (`output/calibration/`; run id checked against the calibrated chunks and
the model outputs in section 2). Nothing is recalibrated here. Performance compares the uncalibrated
(identity) and calibrated JOINT cohort runs (all selected multipliers applied together, exactly as saved) with
the GBD 2023 targets on exactly the same cells: manuscript countries, both sexes, four causes, every age band
and every fitted year. WAPE = sum |predicted - observed| / sum observed; aggregate bias = sum predicted / sum
observed - 1. Both are undefined (shown as "undefined", never 0) when the observed total is 0. All results
are in sample: this is not an external or temporal validation.

```{r calibration}
cfgc <- CALS$config
fit_years <- cfgc$fit_start:cfgc$fit_end
yrs_txt <- function(y) sprintf("%d–%d", min(y), max(y))
CALP <- readRDS(in_files$CALP); setDT(CALP)
need_cols(CALP, c("measure", "location", "sex", "cause", "age_group", "year", "observed", "uncalibrated", "calibrated"), "CALP")
check(setequal(unique(CALP$location), CALS$locations_calibrated), "fit panel locations differ from the calibration run")
check(setequal(unique(CALP$year), fit_years), "fit panel years differ from the saved fitting window")
check(setequal(unique(CALP$age_group), cfgc$age_band_labels) && setequal(unique(CALP$cause), cause_map) &&
      setequal(unique(CALP$sex), cfgc$sexes) && setequal(unique(CALP$measure), c("deaths", "prevalence")),
      "fit panel: unexpected bands, causes, sexes or measures")
check(!anyDuplicated(CALP, by = c("measure", "location", "sex", "cause", "age_group", "year")), "fit panel: duplicated cells")
check(all(is.finite(CALP$observed) & CALP$observed >= 0 & is.finite(CALP$uncalibrated) & is.finite(CALP$calibrated)),
      "fit panel: missing, negative or non-finite values")

n_cells_ms <- length(locs) * length(cfgc$sexes) * length(cause_map) * length(cfgc$age_band_labels) * length(fit_years)
check(nrow(pm) == 2L * n_cells_ms, "fit panel is incomplete for the manuscript countries")

wape_bias <- function(d, by) {
  d[, .(n_countries = uniqueN(location), n_cells = .N, observed = sum(observed), uncalibrated = sum(uncalibrated),
        calibrated = sum(calibrated), abs_err_uncal = sum(abs(uncalibrated - observed)),
        abs_err_cal = sum(abs(calibrated - observed))), keyby = by][
    , `:=`(wape_uncal = fifelse(observed > 0, abs_err_uncal / observed, NA_real_),
           wape_cal   = fifelse(observed > 0, abs_err_cal / observed, NA_real_),
           bias_uncal = fifelse(observed > 0, uncalibrated / observed - 1, NA_real_),
           bias_cal   = fifelse(observed > 0, calibrated / observed - 1, NA_real_))][]
}
# Table S10 rows: overall, then by cause, sex and age band (no region, income or country rows)
levels_tab <- list(
  list(group = "All",               by = NA_character_, order = "All"),
  list(group = "Cause",             by = "cause",       order = unname(cause_map)),
  list(group = "Sex",               by = "sex",         order = cfgc$sexes),
  list(group = "Age group (years)", by = "age_group",   order = cfgc$age_band_labels))
cal_rows <- rbindlist(lapply(seq_along(levels_tab), function(k) {
  L <- levels_tab[[k]]
  if (is.na(L$by)) {
    s <- wape_bias(pm, "measure")[, subgroup := "All"]
  } else {
    s <- wape_bias(pm[!is.na(get(L$by))], c("measure", L$by)); setnames(s, L$by, "subgroup")
  }
  s[, `:=`(group = L$group, g_ord = k, s_ord = match(subgroup, L$order))]
  check(!anyNA(s$s_ord), paste("Table S10: unexpected subgroup in", L$group))
  s
}), use.names = TRUE)
cw <- dcast(cal_rows, g_ord + s_ord + group + subgroup ~ measure,
            value.var = c("n_countries", "n_cells", "observed", "uncalibrated", "calibrated",

                   `Deaths calibrated` = calibrated_deaths,

                   `Prevalent cases bias uncalibrated` = bias_uncal_prevalence, `Prevalent cases bias calibrated` = bias_cal_prevalence)]
pc1 <- function(x, signed = FALSE) ifelse(is.na(x), "undefined",
                                          formatC(100 * x, format = "f", digits = 1, flag = if (signed) "+" else ""))
arrow <- function(a, b, signed = FALSE) paste(pc1(a, signed), "→", pc1(b, signed))

set_sc("cal_cwape_prev_iqr_cal",   100 * cq["prevalence", q1_c], iqr_txt(cq["prevalence", q1_c], cq["prevalence", q3_c]))
scN("cal_n_improve_deaths", cq["deaths", n_improve])
scN("cal_n_improve_prev",   cq["prevalence", n_improve])
scN("cal_n_worse_deaths", cd[measure == "deaths", sum(wape_cal > wape_uncal)])
band_list <- function(ms) {
  b <- cal_rows[group == "Age group (years)" & measure == ms & wape_cal > wape_uncal][order(s_ord), subgroup]
  sub("^([0-9]+)-([0-9]+)$", "\\1\u2013\\2", b)
}
and_list <- function(x) if (length(x) <= 1) x else paste(paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = ", "), "and", x[length(x)])
bands_txt <- function(x) paste("the", and_list(x), if (length(x) == 1) "age band" else "age bands")
bw_d <- band_list("deaths"); bw_p <- band_list("prevalence")
check(length(bw_d) > 0 && length(bw_p) > 0, "text names age bands whose WAPE rose; none did for one measure (update the text)")
set_sc("cal_bands_worse_deaths", length(bw_d), bands_txt(bw_d))
set_sc("cal_bands_worse_prev", length(bw_p), bands_txt(bw_p))
scS("cal_bias_deaths_95_uncal", b95$bias_uncal)
scS("cal_bias_deaths_95_cal",   b95$bias_cal)
scS("cal_sel_J_change_pct",   fm[, sum(sel_error) / sum(id_grid_error) - 1])
scS("cal_joint_J_change_pct", fm[, sum(joint_error) / sum(id_joint_error) - 1])
scN("cal_sel_worsened_n", fm[selection_change == "worsened", .N])
check(SC$cal_sel_worsened_n$value == 0, "a selected grid pair scores worse than the identity (identity is in the grid)")
scN("cal_joint_improved_n", fm[joint_change == "improved", .N])
scP("cal_joint_improved_pct", fm[, mean(joint_change == "improved")])
scN("cal_joint_worsened_n", fm[joint_change == "worsened", .N])
scP("cal_joint_worsened_pct", fm[, mean(joint_change == "worsened")])
set_sc("cal_ir_median", median(fm$ir_mult), formatC(median(fm$ir_mult), format = "f", digits = 2))
set_sc("cal_ir_iqr", quantile(fm$ir_mult, 0.25), iqr_txt(quantile(fm$ir_mult, 0.25), quantile(fm$ir_mult, 0.75), 2, 1))
set_sc("cal_cf_median", median(fm$cf_mult), formatC(median(fm$cf_mult), format = "f", digits = 2))
set_sc("cal_cf_iqr", quantile(fm$cf_mult, 0.25), iqr_txt(quantile(fm$cf_mult, 0.25), quantile(fm$cf_mult, 0.75), 2, 1))
scN("cal_identity_n", fm[is_identity == TRUE, .N])
scN("cal_ir_lower_n", fm[ir_at_lower == TRUE, .N]); scP("cal_ir_lower_pct", fm[, mean(ir_at_lower)])
scN("cal_ir_upper_n", fm[ir_at_upper == TRUE, .N]); scP("cal_ir_upper_pct", fm[, mean(ir_at_upper)])
scN("cal_cf_lower_n", fm[cf_at_lower == TRUE, .N]); scP("cal_cf_lower_pct", fm[, mean(cf_at_lower)])
scN("cal_cf_upper_n", fm[cf_at_upper == TRUE, .N]); scP("cal_cf_upper_pct", fm[, mean(cf_at_upper)])
scP("cal_any_bound_pct", fm[, mean(ir_at_lower | ir_at_upper | cf_at_lower | cf_at_upper)])
scP("cal_cf_capped_pct", cap_share("CF"), 2)
scP("cal_ir_capped_pct", cap_share("IR"), 2)

# the manuscript wording depends on these directions; stop rather than print a false statement
check(ov[, all(wape_cal < wape_uncal)], "text says calibration reduced the WAPE of both measures")
check(b95$bias_uncal < 0 && b95$bias_cal < 0, "text says 95+ deaths remain underestimated before and after")
check(!anyNA(ts10_csv[, ..pct_cols]), "text says no Table S10 group has a zero observed total")
check(SC$cal_n_worse_deaths$value >= 2, "text uses a plural for countries whose deaths WAPE rose")

knitr::kable(ts10_disp, caption = "Table S10")
knitr::kable(fm[, .(strata = .N, identity = sum(is_identity), ir_lower = sum(ir_at_lower), ir_upper = sum(ir_at_upper),
                    cf_lower = sum(cf_at_lower), cf_upper = sum(cf_at_upper),
                    joint_improved = sum(joint_change == "improved"), joint_worsened = sum(joint_change == "worsened")),
                 keyby = age_group][order(match(age_group, cfgc$age_band_labels))],
             caption = "Selected multipliers at grid boundaries and joint-run changes by age band (manuscript countries)")
cat(sprintf("Calibration run %s (completed %s).\n", CALS$run_id, CALS$completed))
```

# 21b. Mortality projection: forecast performance (Table S11) and methods numbers

Reads the saved stage-2 forecast, validation and diagnostics and the model-run manifest (section 2); nothing
is refitted. Holdout: Lee-Carter/ETS base forecasts fitted on 2000-2015 only (with their own covariance),
forecast and reconciled for 2016-2019, and scored against the observed Global rates on the same cells.
ASMR: WHO World Standard Population 2000-2025 rescaled to 20-95+ (setup chunk), the same weights in 2019
and 2050. A four-year Global holdout is not a validation of country forecasts or of intervention effects.

```{r mortality-forecast}
mf_meta <- TRD$meta
mf_comp <- c("ALL.mx", names(cause_map), "BG.mx.all")
mf_label <- c(ALL.mx = "All causes", ihd = "Ischemic heart disease", istroke = "Ischemic stroke",
              hstroke = "Intracerebral hemorrhage", hhd = "Hypertensive heart disease", BG.mx.all = "Other causes")
mf_n_cells <- length(mf_meta$ages) * length(mf_meta$holdout$test)
check(identical(mf_meta$components, mf_comp), "forecast: unexpected hierarchy")
check(nrow(TRV) == 2L * length(mf_comp) && setequal(TRV$component, mf_comp) && setequal(TRV$sex, c("Female", "Male")),
      "validation: unexpected sex x series rows")
check(all(TRV$n == mf_n_cells) && all(TRV$n_expected == mf_n_cells), "validation: holdout cells differ from the age x year grid")
check(nrow(TRD$holdout_cells) == 2L * length(mf_comp) * mf_n_cells, "holdout cells: unexpected count")
check(max(TRD$holdout_cells$year) < min(mf_meta$production$forecast) && min(TRD$holdout_cells$year) > max(mf_meta$holdout$train),
      "holdout cells outside the scoring years")
mf_rc <- TRD$holdout_cells[, .(l = sqrt(mean((log(reconciled) - log(observed))^2)), lb = sqrt(mean((log(base) - log(observed))^2)),
                               r = sqrt(mean((reconciled - observed)^2)), rb = sqrt(mean((base - observed)^2))), by = .(sex, component)]
mf_rc <- mf_rc[TRV, on = .(sex, component)]
check(mf_rc[, max(abs(c(l - rmse_log, lb - rmse_log_base, r - rmse_rate, rb - rmse_rate_base)))] < 1e-12,
      "validation summary does not match the saved holdout cells")

# Additive identity and 2019 anchor on the saved Global panel
mf_w <- dcast(TRC, sex + age + year ~ cause, value.var = "DIS.mx.t0")[
  TRC[cause == "ihd", .(sex, age, year, ALL.mx, BG.mx.all, source)], on = .(sex, age, year)]
mf_idn <- mf_w[, abs(ALL.mx - (ihd + istroke + hstroke + hhd) - BG.mx.all) / ALL.mx]
check(max(mf_idn) <= mf_meta$rel_tol, "forecast: all-cause identity fails")
check(TRC[year == 2019, all(percent_diff_cvd == 0 & percent_diff_bgmx == 0 & percent_diff_bgmx_all == 0)],
      "forecast: the 2019 change is not zero")
check(setequal(mf_w[source == "observed", unique(year)], mf_meta$years_hist) &&
        setequal(mf_w[source == "reconciled_forecast", unique(year)], mf_meta$production$forecast), "forecast: unexpected years")

# ASMR by sex and series: observed 2019, reconciled 2050, unreconciled (base) 2050
mf_w[, cvd := ihd + istroke + hstroke + hhd]
mf_l <- melt(mf_w, id.vars = c("sex", "age", "year"), measure.vars = c(mf_comp, "cvd"), variable.name = "component",
             value.name = "rate", variable.factor = FALSE)
mf_a <- asmr_of(mf_l, c("sex", "component", "year"))
mf_b <- copy(TRD$base_forecast)[, cvd := ihd + istroke + hstroke + hhd]
mf_b <- asmr_of(melt(mf_b[year == 2050], id.vars = c("sex", "age", "year"), measure.vars = c(mf_comp, "cvd"),
                     variable.name = "component", value.name = "rate", variable.factor = FALSE), c("sex", "component", "year"))
mf_asmr <- merge(mf_a[year == 2019, .(sex, component, asmr_2019 = asmr)], mf_a[year == 2050, .(sex, component, asmr_2050 = asmr)],
                 by = c("sex", "component"))
mf_asmr <- merge(mf_asmr, mf_b[, .(sex, component, asmr_2050_base = asmr)], by = c("sex", "component"))
mf_asmr[, `:=`(chg = asmr_2050 / asmr_2019 - 1, chg_base = asmr_2050_base / asmr_2019 - 1)]
mf_g <- function(s, cp, col) mf_asmr[sex == s & component == cp][[col]]
mf_v <- function(s, cp, col) TRV[sex == s & component == cp][[col]]

ts11_csv <- rbindlist(lapply(mf_comp, function(cp) data.table(
  Series = mf_label[[cp]],
  `Female log RMSE reconciled` = mf_v("Female", cp, "rmse_log"), `Female log RMSE base` = mf_v("Female", cp, "rmse_log_base"),
  `Male log RMSE reconciled` = mf_v("Male", cp, "rmse_log"), `Male log RMSE base` = mf_v("Male", cp, "rmse_log_base"),
  `Female rate RMSE reconciled` = mf_v("Female", cp, "rmse_rate"), `Female rate RMSE base` = mf_v("Female", cp, "rmse_rate_base"),
  `Male rate RMSE reconciled` = mf_v("Male", cp, "rmse_rate"), `Male rate RMSE base` = mf_v("Male", cp, "rmse_rate_base"),
  `Holdout cells per sex` = mf_n_cells,
  `Female ASMR 2019` = mf_g("Female", cp, "asmr_2019"), `Female ASMR 2050` = mf_g("Female", cp, "asmr_2050"),
  `Female ASMR 2050 base` = mf_g("Female", cp, "asmr_2050_base"), `Female ASMR change` = mf_g("Female", cp, "chg"),
  `Female ASMR change base` = mf_g("Female", cp, "chg_base"),
  `Male ASMR 2019` = mf_g("Male", cp, "asmr_2019"), `Male ASMR 2050` = mf_g("Male", cp, "asmr_2050"),
  `Male ASMR 2050 base` = mf_g("Male", cp, "asmr_2050_base"), `Male ASMR change` = mf_g("Male", cp, "chg"),
  `Male ASMR change base` = mf_g("Male", cp, "chg_base"))))
fmt_pair <- function(a, b) sprintf("%.4f / %.4f", a, b)
fmt_chg <- function(x) sprintf("%+.1f%%", 100 * x)
ts11_disp <- data.frame(
  Series = ts11_csv$Series,
  "Female holdout log RMSE: reconciled / base" = fmt_pair(ts11_csv$`Female log RMSE reconciled`, ts11_csv$`Female log RMSE base`),
  "Male holdout log RMSE: reconciled / base" = fmt_pair(ts11_csv$`Male log RMSE reconciled`, ts11_csv$`Male log RMSE base`),
  "Female ASMR change, 2019–2050" = fmt_chg(ts11_csv$`Female ASMR change`),
  "Male ASMR change, 2019–2050" = fmt_chg(ts11_csv$`Male ASMR change`), check.names = FALSE)
add_table("TS11_MortalityForecast", ts11_csv, ts11_disp, "reproduced",
          numfmt = c(`Female log RMSE reconciled` = "0.0000", `Female log RMSE base` = "0.0000", `Male log RMSE reconciled` = "0.0000",
                     `Male log RMSE base` = "0.0000", `Female ASMR change` = "0.0%", `Male ASMR change` = "0.0%",
                     `Female ASMR change base` = "0.0%", `Male ASMR change base` = "0.0%"))

# Methods and supplement numbers
set_sc("mf_n_locations", mf_meta$n_locations, as.character(mf_meta$n_locations))
set_sc("mf_fit_years", length(mf_meta$production$train), yrs_txt(mf_meta$production$train))
set_sc("mf_holdout_train", length(mf_meta$holdout$train), yrs_txt(mf_meta$holdout$train))
set_sc("mf_holdout_test", length(mf_meta$holdout$test), yrs_txt(mf_meta$holdout$test))
scN("mf_holdout_cells", mf_n_cells)
mf_better <- TRV[, sum(rmse_log < rmse_log_base)]
set_sc("mf_n_better", mf_better, if (mf_better %in% 1:10) num_word(mf_better) else as.character(mf_better))
set_sc("mf_n_rows", nrow(TRV), as.character(nrow(TRV)))
mf_text_label <- c(ALL.mx = "all causes", ihd = "IHD", istroke = "ischemic stroke", hstroke = "intracerebral hemorrhage",
                   hhd = "hypertensive heart disease", BG.mx.all = "other causes")
mf_list <- function(cp) {
  cp <- mf_comp[mf_comp %in% cp]
  if (!length(cp)) return("none")
  x <- unname(mf_text_label[cp])
  if (length(x) == 1L) x else paste(paste(x[-length(x)], collapse = ", "), "and", x[length(x)])
}
for (s in c("Female", "Male")) {
  k <- if (s == "Female") "f" else "m"
  b <- TRV[sex == s & rmse_log < rmse_log_base, component]
  w <- TRV[sex == s & rmse_log > rmse_log_base, component]
  set_sc(paste0("mf_better_", k), length(b), mf_list(b))
  set_sc(paste0("mf_worse_", k), length(w), mf_list(w))
}
set_sc("mf_identity_err", max(mf_idn), formatC(max(mf_idn), format = "e", digits = 0))
set_sc("mf_dementia_gap_pct", mf_meta$bg_mx_all_gap$pct_deaths_anchor, formatC(mf_meta$bg_mx_all_gap$pct_deaths_anchor, format = "f", digits = 1))
set_sc("mf_cf_share_pct", 100 * MRM$baseline$cf_share, formatC(100 * MRM$baseline$cf_share, format = "f", digits = 0))
scP("mf_asmr_cvd_chg_f", mf_g("Female", "cvd", "chg"), 0)
scP("mf_asmr_cvd_chg_m", mf_g("Male", "cvd", "chg"), 0)
scP("mf_asmr_oth_chg_f", mf_g("Female", "BG.mx.all", "chg"), 0)
scP("mf_asmr_oth_chg_m", mf_g("Male", "BG.mx.all", "chg"), 0)
mf_ihd_m <- mf_a[sex == "Male" & component == "ihd"]
mf_aapc <- function(y0, y1) 100 * ((mf_ihd_m[year == y1, asmr] / mf_ihd_m[year == y0, asmr])^(1 / (y1 - y0)) - 1)
set_sc("mf_ihd_m_obs_aapc", mf_aapc(2010L, 2019L), formatC(mf_aapc(2010L, 2019L), format = "f", digits = 1))
set_sc("mf_ihd_m_fc_aapc", mf_aapc(2019L, 2050L), formatC(mf_aapc(2019L, 2050L), format = "f", digits = 1))
check(mf_aapc(2019L, 2050L) < mf_aapc(2010L, 2019L) && mf_aapc(2010L, 2019L) < 0,
      "the manuscript says the male IHD forecast declines faster than in 2010-2019; the results no longer show this, revise the text")
mf_beta <- TRD$lc[window == "production" & sex == "Male" & component == "ihd", beta]
check(length(mf_beta) == 1L, "forecast diagnostics: one production LC fit expected for male IHD")
set_sc("mf_ihd_m_beta", mf_beta, formatC(mf_beta, format = "f", digits = 2))
mf_guard <- MRM$baseline$accounting_after_guard
scN("mf_guard_bg_cells", mf_guard$n_bg_gap)
scN("mf_guard_cells", mf_guard$cells)
mf_guard_yrs <- mf_guard$bg_gap_by_year$year
set_sc("mf_guard_years", length(mf_guard_yrs),
       if (!length(mf_guard_yrs)) "none" else if (all(diff(mf_guard_yrs) == 1)) yrs_txt(mf_guard_yrs) else paste(mf_guard_yrs, collapse = ", "))
check(mf_guard$n_total_gap == 0 && mf_guard$n_all_spread == 0 && mf_guard$n_other_spread == 0,
      "model run: the final guard changed the shared all-cause or other-cause rates")

knitr::kable(ts11_disp, caption = "Table S11 (display)")
knitr::kable(TRD$jumpoff[, .(sex, component, min = round(min, 3), median = round(median, 3), max = round(max, 3))],
             caption = "Jump-off: first forecast year / observed 2019 Global rate, across ages")
knitr::kable(TRD$lc[window == "production", .(sex, component, var_explained = round(var_explained, 3), alpha = round(alpha, 3),
                                             beta = signif(beta, 3), phi = round(phi, 3))],
             caption = "Production Lee-Carter / damped-ETS fits (2000-2019)")
cat(sprintf("Coherent forecast run %s; model run %s (baseline %s); identity max %.2g; guard breaks BG.mx = ALL - DIS in %d of %d projected cells.\n",
            trend_id, MRM$run_id, MRM$baseline$baseline_id, max(mf_idn), mf_guard$n_bg_gap, mf_guard$cells))
```

# 22. Scalars: assemble, check and save

```{r scalars}
inv_sc <- inventory[type == "scalar"]
missing_sc <- setdiff(inv_sc[status == "reproduced", id], names(SC))
check(length(missing_sc) == 0, paste("reproduced scalars not computed:", paste(missing_sc, collapse = ", ")))
check(length(setdiff(names(SC), inv_sc$id)) == 0, "scalars computed but not in the inventory")
scalars <- inv_sc[, .(key = id, status, unit, location, legacy, source = paste0(inputs, " | ", chunk), filters, method, pending)]
scalars[, value := vapply(key, function(k) if (is.null(SC[[k]])) NA_real_ else SC[[k]]$value, numeric(1))]
scalars[, display := vapply(seq_len(.N), function(i) if (is.null(SC[[key[i]]])) legacy[i] else SC[[key[i]]]$display, character(1))]
scalars[, note := vapply(key, function(k) if (is.null(SC[[k]])) "" else SC[[k]]$note, character(1))]
scalars[status != "reproduced", value := suppressWarnings(as.numeric(gsub(",", "", legacy)))]
scalars[, window := fifelse(status == "reproduced" & grepl("/ 25", method), sprintf("%d-%d (25 implementation years)", yr_impl_start, yr_end),
                     fifelse(status == "reproduced", sprintf("%d-%d (cumulative)", yr_cum_start, yr_end), ""))]
setcolorder(scalars, c("key", "value", "display", "unit", "status", "source", "location", "window", "filters", "method", "pending", "note", "legacy"))
save_rds(scalars[, !"legacy"], "scalars.rds")
```

```{r save-tables}
status_summary <- function(st, cols) {
  apply(st, 1, function(r) if (length(unique(r)) == 1) r[1] else paste(sprintf("%s=%s", cols, r), collapse = "; "))
}
for (sh in names(TB)) {
  x <- copy(TB[[sh]]$csv)
  x[, status := status_summary(TB[[sh]]$status, names(TB[[sh]]$csv))]

}

tables_display <- lapply(TB, function(t) list(df = t$display, bold = t$bold))
save_rds(tables_display, "tables_display.rds")
save_rds(PD, "plot_data.rds")

# provenance: inventory, inputs (md5), settings, session
md5 <- function(f) unname(tools::md5sum(f))
mo_md5 <- md5(mo_files)
tf <- tempfile(); writeLines(paste(basename(mo_files), mo_md5), tf)
inputs_md5 <- rbind(
  data.table(file = "output/out_model/model_output_part_*.rds", n = length(mo_files), md5 = md5(tf)),
  rbindlist(lapply(setdiff(names(in_files), "MO"), function(k) data.table(file = sub(paste0(root, "/"), "", in_files[[k]], fixed = TRUE), n = 1L, md5 = md5(in_files[[k]])))),
  # stage-8 sensitivity runs (Table S8): country files (md5 of the name + md5 list) and manifests
  rbindlist(lapply(names(s8_files), function(b) {
    tfb <- tempfile(); writeLines(paste(basename(s8_files[[b]]), md5(s8_files[[b]])), tfb)
    data.table(file = sprintf(c("output/uncertainty/dsa/out_model_%s/out_model/model_output_part_*.rds", "output/uncertainty/dsa/out_model_%s/dsa_manifest.rds"), b),
               n = c(length(s8_files[[b]]), 1L), md5 = c(md5(tfb), md5(file.path(s8_dsa[block == b, dir], "dsa_manifest.rds"))))
  })))
provenance <- list(
  inventory = inventory, input_legend = input_legend, inputs_md5 = inputs_md5, model_log = mo_log,
  settings = list(yr_impl_start = yr_impl_start, yr_cum_start = yr_cum_start, yr_end = yr_end, n_impl_years = n_impl_years,
                  locs_exclude = locs_exclude, model_parameters = mp),
  calibration = list(run_id = CALS$run_id, completed = CALS$completed, config = CALS$config, checks = CALS$checks,
                     inputs = CALS$inputs, engine = CALS$engine,
                     model_outputs_oldest = format(min(file.mtime(mo_files)), "%Y-%m-%d %H:%M:%S")),
  mortality_trends = list(run_id = trend_id, meta = TRD$meta, validation = TRV, lc = TRD$lc, jumpoff = TRD$jumpoff,
                          covariance = TRD$covariance[, .(max_kappa = max(kappa), min_var = min(min_var)), by = .(sex, window)],
                          standard_population = list(source = "Ahmad et al. 2001, WHO GPE Discussion Paper 31, Table 4 (p. 12)",
                                                     percent_5y = who_std_pct_5y, percent_95plus = who_std_pct_95plus,
                                                     single_age_weights = who_std)),
  model_run = list(run_id = MRM$run_id, started = MRM$started, completed = MRM$completed, baseline = MRM$baseline,
                   runner_md5 = MRM$runner_md5, master_md5 = MRM$master_md5),
  sensitivity = list(window = win_cum, blocks = s8_dsa, labels = s8_lab, runs = s8_prov, model_log = s8_log,
                     manifests = lapply(s8_man, function(M) M[c("run_id", "started", "stage7_started", "completed", "switches", "trend_config",
                                                                "calibration_run_id", "runner_md5", "master_md5", "production", "input_files",
                                                                "trend_files", "code_files", "foresight", "invariant", "expected_countries",
                                                                "scenarios", "reporting_window", "workers", "stage7_minutes", "validation", "session")]),
                     baselines = lapply(s8_man, function(M) M$baseline)),
  parameter_check = param_chk,
  session = list(R = R.version.string, packages = vapply(req_pkgs, function(p) as.character(packageVersion(p)), "")))
save_rds(provenance, "provenance.rds")
```

# 24. Tracking workbook

Rebuilt from the same objects with `openxlsx`. Layout per table sheet: title in row 1, headers in row 3,
data from row 4, a blank row, `Notes:`, then a `Cell status:` legend. Titles and notes are the legacy ones.

```{r workbook}
wb_meta <- data.table(
  sheet = c("T1_Scenarios", "T2_DeathsDelayed", "TS1_Regions", "TS2_CompareIntervention", "TS3_CompareCountry", "TS4_ModelCompare",
            "TS5_Premature_Sex", "TS6_Premature_Top30", "TS7_ByCountry", "TS8_Sensitivity", "TS9_Assumptions",
            "TS10_Calibration", "TS10_Calibration_Detail", "TS11_MortalityForecast"),
  item = c("Table 1", "Table 2", paste0("Table S", 1:10), "Table S10 (companion)", "Table S11"),
  location = c("Main text", "Main text", rep("Supplement", 12)),
  title = c("Intervention scenarios", "Deaths That Could Be Delayed by Different Interventions and Causes (Million)",
            "List of countries in each region.",
            "Estimated Deaths Delayed (Millions) From Scalable Cardiovascular Prevention Interventions: Comparison With Prior Global Modeling Studies by intervention",
            "Estimated Deaths Delayed (Millions) From Scalable Cardiovascular Prevention Interventions: Comparison With Prior Global Modeling Studies by selected countries",
            "Comparison of Modeling Approaches: This study vs Kontis et. al 2019",

st_wrap  <- openxlsx::createStyle(wrapText = TRUE, valign = "top")
st_fill  <- list(reproduced = openxlsx::createStyle(fgFill = "#E2EFDA"), preserved_pending = openxlsx::createStyle(fgFill = "#FFF2CC"),
                 fixed_external = openxlsx::createStyle(fgFill = "#DDEBF7"))
status_legend <- paste("Generated by reports/manuscript-100mlives2-artifacts.Rmd. Shading: green = regenerated from repo inputs/outputs;",
                       "yellow = preserved legacy value, not recalculated (REPRO_PENDING); blue = fixed value quoted from published literature;",
                       "no shading = static author-written content. Do not edit by hand: re-knit the artifact Rmd.")
col_widths <- function(df) pmin(70, pmax(10, vapply(names(df), function(n) max(nchar(n), quantile(nchar(as.character(df[[n]])), 0.9, na.rm = TRUE)), numeric(1)) + 2))
add_sheet <- function(sheet, title, df, notes = NULL, status = NULL, numfmt = character(0), header_row = 3) {
  openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, sheet)
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, sheet, title, startRow = 1, startCol = 1)
  openxlsx::addStyle(wb, sheet, st_title, rows = 1, cols = 1)
  openxlsx::writeData(wb, sheet, as.data.frame(df, check.names = FALSE), startRow = header_row, startCol = 1, headerStyle = st_head)
  n <- nrow(df); k <- ncol(df); rows <- header_row + seq_len(n)
  if (n) openxlsx::addStyle(wb, sheet, st_wrap, rows = rows, cols = seq_len(k), gridExpand = TRUE)
  for (j in names(numfmt)) openxlsx::addStyle(wb, sheet, openxlsx::createStyle(numFmt = numfmt[[j]]), rows = rows, cols = match(j, names(df)), stack = TRUE)
  if (!is.null(status)) for (s in names(st_fill)) {
    idx <- which(status == s, arr.ind = TRUE)
    if (nrow(idx)) openxlsx::addStyle(wb, sheet, st_fill[[s]], rows = header_row + idx[, 1], cols = idx[, 2], gridExpand = FALSE, stack = TRUE)
  }
  if (!is.null(notes)) {
    openxlsx::writeData(wb, sheet, data.frame(a = "Notes:", b = notes), startRow = header_row + n + 2, colNames = FALSE)
    openxlsx::writeData(wb, sheet, data.frame(a = "Cell status:", b = status_legend), startRow = header_row + n + 3, colNames = FALSE)
  }
  openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, sheet, cols = seq_len(k), widths = col_widths(df))
  sprintf("A%d:%s%d", header_row, openxlsx::int2col(k), header_row + n)
}
idx_rows <- list()
openxlsx::addWorksheet(wb, "Index")
openxlsx::writeData(wb, "Index", "RTSL 100M Lives manuscript – tables and figures tracker", startRow = 1)
openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "Index", st_title, rows = 1, cols = 1)
for (i in seq_len(nrow(wb_meta))) {

  rng <- add_sheet(m$sheet, sprintf("%s. %s", m$item, m$title), t$csv, m$notes, t$status, t$numfmt)
  st <- unique(as.vector(t$status))
  idx_rows[[i]] <- data.table(Sheet = m$sheet, Item = m$item, Title = m$title, Location = m$location, `Data range` = rng,
                              Notes = m$notes, Status = if (length(st) == 1) st else paste(sort(st), collapse = " + "))
}
math_idx <- data.table(Sheet = "(CSV only)", Item = "Math supplement (unnumbered)", Title = vapply(math_md, `[[`, "", "caption"),

                        Notes = notes[1], Status = paste(unique(status), collapse = " + ")), by = .(Item = figure)]

index <- rbind(rbindlist(idx_rows), math_idx, fig_idx)
openxlsx::writeData(wb, "Index", paste0("Generated by reports/manuscript-100mlives2-artifacts.Rmd on ", build_date,
                    ". For tracking and review only: the manuscript reads manuscript/artifacts/*.rds, not this workbook. Do not edit by hand."), startRow = 2)
openxlsx::writeData(wb, "Index", index, startRow = 4, headerStyle = st_head)
openxlsx::addStyle(wb, "Index", st_wrap, rows = 4 + seq_len(nrow(index)), cols = seq_len(ncol(index)), gridExpand = TRUE)
openxlsx::setColWidths(wb, "Index", cols = seq_len(ncol(index)), widths = c(24, 12, 60, 12, 18, 70, 24))

figs_sheet <- fig_meta[, .(Figure = figure, Panel = panel, Title = title, `File (figures/...)` = paste0("figures/", file), Location = location,
                           `Notes (short)` = notes, `Last updated` = ifelse(status == "reproduced", build_date, "2026-02-04 (from WG manuscript)"),
                           `Status / comments` = ifelse(status == "reproduced", "reproduced: regenerated by the artifact Rmd",
                                                        paste("preserved_pending: legacy PNG kept;", inventory[match(file, id), pending])),
                           Preview = "")]
add_sheet("Figures", "Figures (image files live in the figures/ folder next to the Rmd)", figs_sheet,
          status = matrix(ifelse(figs_sheet$`Status / comments` %like% "^reproduced", "reproduced", "preserved_pending"), nrow(figs_sheet), ncol(figs_sheet)))
sc_sheet <- scalars[, .(Key = key, Display = display, `Manuscript location` = location, Unit = unit, Status = status, Value = value,
                        Window = window, Source = source, Note = note, Pending = pending, `Legacy display` = legacy)]
add_sheet("Scalars", "Numbers used in the manuscript text", sc_sheet,
          status = matrix(rep(sc_sheet$Status, ncol(sc_sheet)), nrow(sc_sheet), ncol(sc_sheet)), numfmt = c(Value = "0.000"))
prov_sheet <- inventory[, .(`Artifact ID` = id, Type = type, `Manuscript location` = location, Inputs = inputs, Filters = filters,
                            Method = method, `Report chunk` = chunk, `Output path` = output, Status = status, `Pending dependency` = pending)]
add_sheet("Provenance", "Provenance of every manuscript number, table and figure (input codes: see the artifact Rmd, section 1)", prov_sheet)
openxlsx::worksheetOrder(wb) <- match(c("Index", wb_meta$sheet, "Figures", "Scalars", "Provenance"), names(wb))
openxlsx::saveWorkbook(wb, xlsx_out, overwrite = TRUE)
```

# 25. Integrity checks

```{r integrity}
t2c <- TB$T2_DeathsDelayed$csv
chk <- list(
  "BAU/intervention keys match (no DD stratum without BAU)" = nrow(D[!B, on = .(location, cause, sex, age_group, year)]) == 0,
  "no duplicated strata after dropping non-finite rows" = all(mo_log$duplicated_strata == 0),
  "pop and all.mx identical across the four cause models" = max(mo_log$cause_copy_deviation) < 1e-8,
  "deaths delayed in 2025 are zero" = D[year == 2025, sum(abs(dd))] < 1e-6,
  "per-year divisor = years 2026-2050 inclusive" = n_impl_years == length(2026:2050),
  "cause rows sum to all-CVD (BAU)" = abs(s_cause[int == "All", sum(bau)] - g(s_int, "bau", int = "All")) < 1e-3,
  "cause rows sum to all-CVD (DD, each intervention)" = all(abs(s_cause[, .(d = sum(dd)), by = int][s_int, on = "int", d - i.dd]) < 1e-3),
  "sex, age and region partitions sum to totals" = all(abs(c(s_sex[int == "All", sum(dd)], s_age[int == "All", sum(dd)], s_reg[int == "All", sum(dd)]) - dd_all) < 1e-3),
  "percentages are proportions in tables (0-1)" = all(between(c(t2c$`Deaths Delayed (%)`, TB$TS5_Premature_Sex$csv[[4]], TB$TS6_Premature_Top30$csv[[3]], TB$TS7_ByCountry$csv$`% Delayed`), -1, 1)),
  "no missing or non-finite reproduced values" = all(is.finite(unlist(lapply(TB[c("T2_DeathsDelayed", "TS5_Premature_Sex", "TS6_Premature_Top30", "TS7_ByCountry")], function(t) unlist(t$csv[, which(vapply(t$csv, is.numeric, TRUE)), with = FALSE]))))),
  "scalar dd_all_total equals Table 2 All row" = abs(SC$dd_all_total_M$value - t2c[Cause == "All CVDs" & Intervention == "All Interventions", `Deaths Delayed (M)`]) < 1e-9,
  "Table S2 this-study equals Table 2 all-CVD rows" = all(abs(TB$TS2_CompareIntervention$csv[[2]] - t2c[Cause == "All CVDs"][match(TB$TS2_CompareIntervention$csv$Intervention, Intervention), `Deaths Delayed (M)`]) < 1e-9),
  "Table S3 this-study equals Table S7" = all(abs(TB$TS3_CompareCountry$csv[[2]] * 1e6 - TB$TS7_ByCountry$csv[match(TB$TS3_CompareCountry$csv$Country, Location), `Deaths Delayed`]) < 1e-3),
  "Table S7 sums to the global total" = abs(sum(TB$TS7_ByCountry$csv$`Deaths Delayed`) - dd_all) < 1e-3,
  "Table S5 All rows sum to dd_all_u70" = abs(sum(TB$TS5_Premature_Sex$csv[Intervention == "All Interventions", `Deaths Delayed (#)`]) - SC$dd_all_u70_M$value * 1e6) < 1e-3,
  "Table S6 shares match Table S7 totals" = all(abs(TB$TS6_Premature_Top30$csv[[2]] / TB$TS6_Premature_Top30$csv[[3]] - TB$TS7_ByCountry$csv[match(TB$TS6_Premature_Top30$csv$Location, Location), `Deaths Delayed`]) < 1e-3),
  "Figure 1 data sum to single-intervention totals" = all(abs(f1[, .(d = sum(dd)), by = int][s_int, on = "int", nomatch = 0L, d - i.dd]) < 1e-3),
  "Figure 2 data sum to intervention totals" = all(abs(f2[, .(d = sum(dd)), by = int][s_int, on = "int", d - i.dd]) < 1e-3),
  "Figure 4 panels each sum to single-intervention totals" = all(abs(f4[, .(d = sum(dd)), by = .(int, disaggregation)][s_int, on = "int", nomatch = 0L, d - i.dd]) < 1e-3),
  "Table S1 lists every modelled country once" = setequal(unlist(strsplit(TB$TS1_Regions$csv$Countries, ", ", fixed = TRUE)), locs),
  "Table S6 country set = 30 largest adult populations in 2025" = length(unique(TB$TS6_Premature_Top30$csv$Location)) == 30,
  "math tables verbatim in the manuscript" = all(math_in_ms),
  "every figure referenced by the manuscript exists" = all(file.exists(file.path(dir_fig, fig_meta$file))),
  "every manuscript table has a CSV" = all(file.exists(file.path(dir_tab, paste0(c(wb_meta$sheet, names(math_md)), ".csv")))),
  "calibration: chunks, fit panel and model outputs from one run (section 2)" = length(mo_stale) == 0 && setequal(basename(in_files$BR), CALS$out_files),
  "calibration: Table S10 All row equals Figure S6 totals" =
    isTRUE(all.equal(f6[, .(v = sum(value)), keyby = .(measure, series)]$v,
                     as.vector(t(as.matrix(ov[order(measure), .(observed, uncalibrated, calibrated)]))), tolerance = 1e-12)),
  "calibration: country-level summary (text scalars) sums to the Table S10 All row" =
    all(abs(as.matrix(cd[, .(sum(observed), sum(calibrated)), keyby = measure][, -1]) -
            as.matrix(ov[order(measure), .(observed, calibrated)])) < 1e-3),
  "calibration: Table S10 has only the All, Cause, Sex and Age group rows" =
    setequal(ts10_csv$Group, c("All", "Cause", "Sex", "Age group (years)")),
  "calibration: every subgroup partition sums to the All row (deaths observed)" =
    all(abs(ts10_csv[Group %in% c("Cause", "Sex", "Age group (years)"), sum(`Deaths observed`), by = Group]$V1 -
            ts10_csv[Group == "All", `Deaths observed`]) < 1e-3),
  "calibration: WAPE scalars equal Table S10 All row" =
    abs(SC$cal_wape_deaths_cal$value / 100 - ts10_csv[Group == "All", `Deaths WAPE calibrated`]) < 1e-12 &&
    abs(SC$cal_wape_prev_uncal$value / 100 - ts10_csv[Group == "All", `Prevalent cases WAPE uncalibrated`]) < 1e-12,
  "calibration: country-level summary covers the manuscript countries" = setequal(cd$location, locs),
  "trends: model outputs are the files written by the coherent-trend run in the manifest (section 2)" =
    identical(MRM$baseline$trend_method, "coherent") && all(MRM$files$written_this_run) &&
    identical(MRM$files[match(basename(mo_files), file), md5], mo_md5),
  "trends: forecast, validation, diagnostics and model run share one forecast run id" =
    identical(attr(TRV, "trend_run_id"), trend_id) && identical(MRM$baseline$trend_run_id, trend_id),
  "trends: Table S11 has the six series in hierarchy order" = identical(ts11_csv$Series, unname(mf_label[mf_comp])),
  "trends: holdout cells per sex and series = ages x scoring years" = all(TRV$n == mf_n_cells),
  "trends: Global identity ALL = four causes + other within tolerance" = max(mf_idn) <= mf_meta$rel_tol,
  "trends: coherent country accounting held before the guard in the model run" =
    with(MRM$baseline$accounting_before_guard, n_all_spread + n_other_spread + n_total_gap + n_bg_gap) == 0,
  "Table S8: base rows equal the Table 2 all-CVD rows (2026-2050)" = local({
    ts8c <- TB$TS8_Sensitivity$csv[seq_along(s8_int)]; t2a <- t2c[Cause == "All CVDs"][match(ts8c$Intervention, Intervention)]
    max(abs(ts8c$`Projected Deaths (M)` - t2a$`Projected Deaths, Intervention (M)`), abs(ts8c$`Baseline Deaths (M)` - t2a$`Projected Deaths, Business as Usual (M)`),
        abs(ts8c$`Deaths Delayed (M)` - t2a$`Deaths Delayed (M)`), abs(ts8c$`Deaths Delayed per Year (M)` - t2a$`Deaths Delayed per Year (M)`),
        abs(ts8c$`Deaths Delayed (%)` - t2a$`Deaths Delayed (%)`)) < 1e-12 }),
  "Table S8: every row has DD = BAU - projected, % = DD / BAU and per year = DD / 25" = local({
    x <- TB$TS8_Sensitivity$csv
    max(abs(x$`Baseline Deaths (M)` - x$`Projected Deaths (M)` - x$`Deaths Delayed (M)`)) < 1e-9 &&
      max(abs(x$`Deaths Delayed (%)` - x$`Deaths Delayed (M)` / x$`Baseline Deaths (M)`)) < 1e-12 &&
      max(abs(x$`Deaths Delayed per Year (M)` - x$`Deaths Delayed (M)` / length(2026:2050))) < 1e-12 }),
  "Table S8: each trend block has one BAU, from its own run" =
    TB$TS8_Sensitivity$csv[, uniqueN(`Baseline Deaths (M)`), by = `Mortality Trend Modeling`][, all(V1 == 1L)] &&
    uniqueN(TB$TS8_Sensitivity$csv$`Baseline Deaths (M)`) == length(s8_lab),
  "Table S8: sensitivity runs complete, validated, same calibration, runner, inputs and countries (section 19)" =
    length(s8_man) == nrow(s8_dsa) && all(vapply(s8_man, function(M) identical(M$status, "complete") && identical(M$calibration_run_id, CALS$run_id) &&
                                                   identical(M$runner_md5, MRM$runner_md5) && setequal(M$expected_countries, locs), logical(1))),
  "Table S8: sensitivity scalars equal the All rows" =
    all(abs(c(SC$sens_no_trend_dd_M$value, SC$sens_lc_dd_M$value, SC$sens_foresight_dd_M$value) -
              ts8[int == "All"][match(c("no_trends", "lc", "ihme_foresight"), block), dd / 1e6]) < 1e-12) &&
    abs(SC$sens_pct_range$value - 100 * min(ts8[int == "All", pct])) < 1e-12)
integrity <- data.table(check = names(chk), passed = unlist(chk))
knitr::kable(integrity, caption = "Integrity checks")
check(all(integrity$passed), paste("integrity checks failed:", paste(integrity[!(passed), check], collapse = "; ")))
knitr::kable(fig3_range[, .(sex, min = round(min, 1), max = round(max, 1))],
             caption = "Figure 3: range of % reductions by sex (the lowest legend bin is labelled 5-9% but holds everything up to 9%)")
knitr::kable(f3[pct < 5, .(location, sex, pct = round(pct, 1))], caption = "Figure 3: countries below 5% (shown in the 5-9% bin)")
```

```{r discrepancies}
cmp_cells <- function(table, rowid, column, legacy, reproduced) {
  data.table(item = paste0(table, ": ", column), row = rowid, legacy, reproduced = fcoalesce(reproduced, "(not in table)"))
}
by_loc <- function(tab, col, loc) TB[[tab]]$display[[col]][match(loc, TB[[tab]]$csv[[1]])]

  rbindlist(lapply(1:5, function(j) cmp_cells("T2_DeathsDelayed", paste(d2$Cause, d2$Intervention, sep = " / "), names(d2)[j + 2], leg_t2_disp[[j]], d2[[j + 2]]))),
  cmp_cells("TS5_Premature_Sex", paste(TB$TS5_Premature_Sex$csv$Intervention, TB$TS5_Premature_Sex$csv$Sex), "Deaths Delayed (#)", fmt_int(leg_ts5$dd), TB$TS5_Premature_Sex$display[[3]]),
  cmp_cells("TS5_Premature_Sex", paste(TB$TS5_Premature_Sex$csv$Intervention, TB$TS5_Premature_Sex$csv$Sex), "Deaths Delayed (<70 years %)", fmt_pct(leg_ts5$pct, 1), TB$TS5_Premature_Sex$display[[4]]),
  cmp_cells("TS6_Premature_Top30", "row order and country set", "Location", paste(leg_ts6$Location, collapse = ";"), paste(TB$TS6_Premature_Top30$csv$Location, collapse = ";")),
  cmp_cells("TS6_Premature_Top30", leg_ts6$Location, "Projected Deaths Delayed <70 years", fmt_int(leg_ts6$dd), by_loc("TS6_Premature_Top30", 2, leg_ts6$Location)),
  cmp_cells("TS6_Premature_Top30", leg_ts6$Location, "Share of delayed deaths occurring <70 years (%)", fmt_pct(leg_ts6$share, 1), by_loc("TS6_Premature_Top30", 3, leg_ts6$Location)),
  cmp_cells("TS7_ByCountry", "row order", "Location", paste(leg_ts7$Location, collapse = ";"), paste(TB$TS7_ByCountry$csv$Location, collapse = ";")),
  rbindlist(lapply(c("proj", "bau", "dd", "per_year"), function(v)
    cmp_cells("TS7_ByCountry", leg_ts7$Location, v, fmt_int(leg_ts7[[v]]),
              by_loc("TS7_ByCountry", match(v, c("Location", "proj", "bau", "dd", "per_year")), leg_ts7$Location)))),
  cmp_cells("TS7_ByCountry", leg_ts7$Location, "% Delayed (legacy stored at 2 decimals)", fmt_pct(leg_ts7$pct, 0), by_loc("TS7_ByCountry", 6, leg_ts7$Location)),
  cmp_cells("TS2_CompareIntervention", TB$TS2_CompareIntervention$csv$Intervention, "This study", fmt_num(leg_ts2_this, 1), TB$TS2_CompareIntervention$display[[2]]),
  cmp_cells("TS3_CompareCountry", TB$TS3_CompareCountry$csv$Country, "This study", fmt_num(leg_ts3_this, 1), TB$TS3_CompareCountry$display[[2]]),
  cmp_cells("T1_Scenarios", TB$T1_Scenarios$csv$Intervention[2:4], "Baseline level (2025)", leg_t1_base, TB$T1_Scenarios$display$`Baseline level (2025)`[2:4]),
  cmp_cells("TS1_Regions", TB$TS1_Regions$csv$Region, "Countries", leg_ts1, TB$TS1_Regions$csv$Countries)))
tab_diff <- tab_cmp[legacy != reproduced]
tab_diff_summary <- tab_diff[, .(cells_differing = .N, example_row = row[1], example_legacy = substr(legacy[1], 1, 60),
                                 example_reproduced = substr(reproduced[1], 1, 60)), by = item]
disc <- rbind(sc_cmp[, .(item, cells_differing = 1L, example_row = "", example_legacy = legacy, example_reproduced = reproduced)], tab_diff_summary)
window_note <- sprintf("BAU now summed over %d-2050 (stated horizon); legacy used 2025-2050. Deaths delayed unchanged.", yr_cum_start)
window_dep <- c(scalars[status == "reproduced" & grepl("^(pct_|one_in_n)|^bau_total|^proj_all", key), key],
                "T2_DeathsDelayed: Projected Deaths, Intervention", "T2_DeathsDelayed: Projected Deaths, Business as Usual",
                "T2_DeathsDelayed: Deaths Delayed (%)", "TS7_ByCountry: proj", "TS7_ByCountry: bau")
disc[, explanation := fifelse(item %in% names(explain), explain[item], fifelse(item %in% window_dep, window_note, ""))]
knitr::kable(disc, caption = sprintf("Reproduced values that differ from the legacy display (%d scalars, %d table cells compared)",
                                     scalars[status == "reproduced", .N], nrow(tab_cmp)))
if (nrow(tab_diff)) knitr::kable(tab_diff[order(item)][, head(.SD, 60)], caption = "Differing table cells (first 60)")
knitr::kable(data.table(table_S3 = ts3_ext$location, top15_this_study = ts3_top15, in_table_S3 = ts3_top15 %in% ts3_ext$location),
             caption = "Table S3 countries (Kontis top 15) vs the 15 largest deaths-delayed totals in this study")

# Effect of the window change on the headline estimands: legacy 2025-2050 vs the 2026-2050 window used here
alt <- summ(years = 2025L:yr_end)
knitr::kable(merge(alt[, .(int, bau_2025 = round(bau / 1e6, 1), pct_2025 = round(100 * pct, 1))],
                   s_int[, .(int, bau_used = round(bau / 1e6, 1), pct_used = round(100 * pct, 1), dd_M = round(dd / 1e6, 1))], by = "int"),
             caption = sprintf("Cumulative totals: legacy 2025-2050 vs %d-2050 (used)", yr_cum_start))
```
